items.titleEn: Watch Blue Jays prospects in Arizona Fall League action
bodyEn: The World Series is over but you can still watch live baseball featuring many of baseball's top up-and-coming players.

The 34th annual Arizona Fall League season is in full swing, and you can watch top prospects from all 30 MLB organizations throughout November as AFL matchups are once again streaming for free on both MLB.com (here and on the AFL site) and MLB.TV.

All but five games of the 90-game regular season are available to stream completely free, along with the AFL Home Run Derby, Fall Stars Game, Quarterfinals, Semifinals and Championship Game. Additionally, the Fall Stars Game (Nov. 8) and Championship Game (Nov. 14) will be broadcast on MLB Network.

Several winter league games are also available to stream on MLB.TV. The Brewers' Jesús Made, MLB's No. 1 prospect, headlines a group of six Top 100 prospects in the Dominican League, while Alberto Barriga (AZ No. 16) is among those in action in the Mexican League.
Here are the Fall League teams and their MLB affiliations:

Glendale Desert Dogs: Braves, Dodgers, Marlins, Pirates, White SoxMesa Solar Sox: Angels, Athletics, Blue Jays, Cubs, Red SoxPeoria Javelinas: Cardinals, Mariners, Orioles, Padres, RedsSalt River Rafters: D-backs, Nationals, Rockies, Twins, YankeesScottsdale Scorpions: Astros, Brewers, Giants, Rays, TigersSurprise Saguaros: Guardians, Mets, Phillies, Rangers, Royals
And here's a look at the upcoming matchups:
FRIDAY

Toros del Este vs. Tigres del Licey, 6:30 p.m. ETJustin Gonzales (BOS 2/MLB 71) showed real power in his bat and arm during the regular season, tallying 19 homers and an .834 OPS between High-A and Double-A. MLB’s No. 1 prospect Jesús Made (MIL 1) stars for Licey alongside Hayden Álvarez (LAA 3/MLB 98). Made slashed .318/.423/.409 through his first 52 plate appearances this winter, and Álvarez posted a .289/.391/.456 slash line with 49 extra-base hits and 53 stolen bases over 118 total games between Single-A and High-A during the Minor League season.

Salt River (AZ, COL, MIN, NYY, WSH) vs. Surprise (CLE, KC, NYM, PHI, TEX), 8:30 p.m. ETIn a matchup of two Hitter of the Week winners, the Rockies' Jack O’Dowd led sluggers with three homers, 17 total bases, a 1.308 slugging percentage and a 1.770 OPS for the Rafters during the third week on the circuit. Welbyn Francisco (CLE 19) has stayed hot after earning the campaign's first Hitter of the Week honors behind 10 knocks and seven RBIs across four contests for the Saguaros.

Glendale (ATL, CWS, LAD, MIA, PIT) vs. Scottsdale (DET, HOU, MIL, SF, TB), 8:30 p.m. ETChase Harlan (LAD 9) has been one of the best hitters for the Desert Dogs this season. The 2024 third-rounder posted a 1.009 OPS with 10 homers and 17 doubles at Single-A during the regular season. Scottsdale counters with Luke Davis (PHI), who collected his first homer of the Fall League on Monday and sported a 1.017 OPS through 12 games. The 23-year-old catcher boasts elite plate discipline too.
SATURDAY

Gigantes del Cibao vs. Tigres de Licey, 4 p.m. ETFour of the six highest-ranked prospects in winter ball headline this matchup. The group is led by Jesús Made (MIL 1/MLB 1), who announced his presence for Licey by homering in his first LIDOM at-bat. Opposite the toolsy shortstop will be electric bats Emil Morales (LAD 4/MLB 22), Roldy Brito (COL 2/MLB 52) and Jefferson Rojas (NYM 1/MLB 68). Morales was the only teenage shortstop to reach 25+ homers during the Minor League season.

Leones del Escogido vs. Estrellas Orientales, 6:30 p.m. ETFresh off a campaign in which he became the first Minor League catcher to go 30-30 since 1981, Jason Schiavone (HOU 6) is looking to bolster his resume even further with Escogido. On the other side of the contest will be fellow catcher Leo Bernal (STL 4/MLB 80). Known for his defensive prowess, Bernal produced an .807 OPS and hit five homers during a 24-game big league cameo this past season.

Arizona Fall League Home Run Derby, 8:30 p.m. ETEight of the Fall League's top slugging prospects are preparing to put on a show in the fourth annual Home Run Derby, featuring a single-elimination, head-to-head format. Chase Harlan (LAD 9), Alex McCoy (SD 26) and Eric Bitonti (MIL 26) headline this year's participants looking to launch their way to the desert’s long-ball crown. More >>
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
SUNDAY

Tigres de Licey vs. Leones del Escogido, 4 p.m. ETMLB’s No. 1 prospect Jesús Made (MIL 1) leads the way for Licey alongside Hayden Álvarez (LAA 3/MLB 98). Made slashed .318/.423/.409 through his first 52 plate appearances this winter, and Álvarez posted a .289/.391/.456 slash line with 49 extra-base hits and 53 stolen bases over 118 games between Single-A and High-A during the regular season. In the other dugout, Jason Schiavone (HOU 6) highlights the lineup for Escogido after making history earlier this year for becoming the first Minor League catcher to go 30-30 since 1981.

Águilas Cibaeñas vs. Gigantes del Cibao, 4 p.m. ETA trio of Top 100 prospects anchors the offense for the Gigantes. Each comes equipped with one of the most electric bats in winter ball. Emil Morales (LAD 4/MLB 22), Roldy Brito (COL 2/MLB 52) and Jefferson Rojas (NYM 1/MLB 68) all have the ability to put a charge into the ball with a single swing. Morales was the only teenage shortstop to reach 25+ homers during the Minor League campaign.

Estrellas Orientales vs. Toros del Este, 4 p.m.The Estrellas' Leo Bernal (STL 4/MLB 80) showed this year that there isn’t much he can’t do at an elite level. After making a name for himself with his defensive prowess, Bernal produced an .807 OPS during a 24-game big league cameo. The Orientales' lineup also features Ronny Cruz (WSH No. 7). On the other side, Justin Gonzales (BOS 2/MLB 71) displayed plus power with 19 dingers and an .834 OPS between High-A and Double-A.

Arizona Fall League Fall Stars Game, 8 p.m. ETThe 20th annual Arizona Fall League showcase will bring top prospects from 29 organizations onto the field for a star-studded event. The group features 10 of MLB Pipeline’s Top 100 prospects, including Sebastian Walcott (TEX 1/MLB 8), Arjun Nimmala (LAA 1/MLB 34) and Aidan Miller (PHI 2/MLB 59). Divided into American League and National League squads, the Fall Stars Game offers a special opportunity to catch some of baseball’s best young prospects banding together further in the desert. items.titleZh: 收看亚利桑那秋季联赛的蓝鸟潜力新秀
items.summaryZh: 世界大赛虽已结束，球迷仍可通过MLB平台免费收看亚利桑那秋季联赛，关注各大俱乐部的顶尖潜力新秀。
bodyZh: 世界大赛已经结束，但你仍然可以观看汇聚了棒球界众多顶尖明日之星的现场比赛。
第34届年度亚利桑那秋季联赛正在如火如荼地进行中。在整个11月期间，你可以观赏来自全部30支大联盟球队的顶级潜力新秀，秋季联赛的比赛将再次在MLB.com（包括官网及秋季联赛专区）和MLB.TV上进行免费直播。
在90场常规赛中，除5场比赛外，其余所有比赛均可完全免费观看，同时还有秋季联赛本垒打大赛、秋星赛、四分之一决赛、半决赛和冠军赛。此外，秋星赛（11月8日）和冠军赛（11月14日）也将在MLB Network上进行转播。
多场冬季联赛的比赛同样可以通过MLB.TV进行观看。密尔沃基酿酒人的Jesús Made作为大联盟头号潜力新秀，领衔多米尼加联赛的6位百大潜力新秀，而Alberto Barriga（亚利桑那响尾蛇第16号）则活跃在墨西哥联赛的赛场上。
以下是秋季联赛的球队及其所属的大联盟球队：

格伦代尔沙漠狗：亚特兰大勇士、洛杉矶道奇、迈阿密马林鱼、匹兹堡海盗、芝加哥白袜；梅萨太阳索克斯：洛杉矶天使、运动家、多伦多蓝鸟、芝加哥小熊、波士顿红袜；皮奥里亚标枪猪：圣路易斯红雀、西雅图水手、巴尔的摩金莺、圣迭戈教士、辛辛那提红人；盐河 rafters：亚利桑那响尾蛇、华盛顿国民、科罗拉多洛矶、明尼苏达双城、纽约洋基；斯科茨代尔蝎子：休斯敦太空人、密尔沃基酿酒人、旧金山巨人、坦帕湾光芒、底特律老虎；瑟普赖斯 saguaros：克利夫兰守护者、纽约大都会、费城费城人、得克萨斯游骑兵、堪萨斯城皇家。
以下是接下来即将进行的比赛看点：
星期五

东部多罗斯 vs. 利西老虎，美东时间下午6点30分Justin Gonzales（波士顿红袜第2号/大联盟第71号）在常规赛期间展现出真正的打击和传球力量，在高阶1A和2A之间总共轰出19支本垒打，攻击指数达到.834。大联盟头号潜力新秀Jesús Made（密尔沃基酿酒人第1号）将与Hayden Álvarez（洛杉矶天使第3号/大联盟第98号）一同为利西出战。在本赛季冬天的前52个打席中，Made交出了.318/.423/.409的三围打击率，而Álvarez在小联盟赛季效力于1A和高阶1A的118场总比赛中，交出了.289/.391/.456的三围打击率，并有49支长打和53次盗垒。

盐河（亚利桑那响尾蛇、科罗拉多洛矶、明尼苏达双城、纽约洋基、华盛顿国民） vs. 瑟普赖斯（克利夫兰守护者、堪萨斯城皇家、纽约大都会、费城费城人、得克萨斯游骑兵），美东时间晚上8点30分在这场汇集了两位周最佳打者奖得主的较量中，科罗拉多洛矶的Jack O’Dowd在联赛第三周表现出色，为拉夫特斯队轰出3支本垒打、得到17个垒打数，长打率高达1.308，攻击指数达到1.770。Welbyn Francisco（克利夫兰守护者第19号）在为萨瓜罗队出战的4场比赛中敲出10支安打并贡献7分打点，荣膺本赛季首个周最佳打者后依然火热。

格伦代尔（亚特兰大勇士、芝加哥白袜、洛杉矶道奇、迈阿密马林鱼、匹兹堡海盗） vs. 斯科茨代尔（底特律老虎、休斯敦太空人、密尔沃基酿酒人、旧金山巨人、坦帕湾光芒），美东时间晚上8点30分Chase Harlan（洛杉矶道奇第9号）是本赛季沙漠狗队表现最出色的打者之一。这位2024年的三轮秀在常规赛效力1A期间交出了1.009的攻击指数，并有10支本垒打和17支二垒安打。斯科茨代尔则由Luke Davis（费城费城人）迎战，他在周一打出了秋季联赛的个人首支本垒打，在12场比赛中保持着1.017的攻击指数。这位23岁的捕手同时也具备顶尖的选球纪律。
星期六

西巴奥巨人 vs. 利西老虎，美东时间下午4点这场对决汇聚了冬联中排名最高的6位潜力新秀中的4位。其中领衔的是Jesús Made（密尔沃基酿酒人第1号/大联盟第1号），他在代表利西出战的LIDOM首个打席就轰出本垒打，宣告了自己的到来。与这位技巧出众的游击手对阵的将是火力十足的Emil Morales（洛杉矶道奇第4号/大联盟第22号）、Roldy Brito（科罗拉多洛矶第2号/大联盟第52号）和Jefferson Rojas（纽约大都会第1号/大联盟第68号）。Morales是小联盟赛季中唯一一位轰出25支以上本垒打的十几岁游击手。

埃斯科希多狮子 vs. 东方之星，美东时间下午6点30分Jason Schiavone（休斯敦太空人第6号）刚刚在今年成为自1981年以来首位达成单季“30-30”（30轰30盗）的小联盟捕手，如今他正力求在埃斯科希多队进一步擦亮自己的招牌。比赛的另一端则是同为捕手的Leo Bernal（圣路易斯红雀第4号/大联盟第80号）。Bernal以出色的防守能力闻名，他在本赛季的大联盟短暂登场24场比赛中打出了.807的攻击指数并轰出5支本垒打。
亚利桑那秋季联赛本垒打大赛，美东时间晚上8点30分秋季联赛中最具长打能力的8位潜力新秀正准备在第四届年度本垒打大赛中上演精彩表演，比赛将采用单败淘汰制的对决形式。Chase Harlan（洛杉矶道奇第9号）、Alex McCoy（圣迭戈教士第26号）和Eric Bitonti（密尔沃基酿酒人第26号）领衔今年的参赛阵容，他们都渴望在沙漠中摘得长打王桂冠。了解更多 >>
订阅 MLB Pipeline 通讯
星期日

利西老虎 vs. 埃斯科希多狮子，美东时间下午4点大联盟头号潜力新秀Jesús Made（密尔沃基酿酒人第1号）携手Hayden Álvarez（洛杉矶天使第3号/大联盟第98号）共同领衔利西阵容。Made在今年冬天的前52个打席中交出了.318/.423/.409的三围打击率，而Álvarez在常规赛效力1A和高阶1A的118场比赛中，交出了.289/.391/.456的三围打击率，并有49支长打和53次盗垒。在另一侧的休息区，Jason Schiavone（休斯敦太空人第6号）则成为了埃斯科希多阵容的亮点，他此前在今年早些时候创造历史，成为了自1981年以来首位达成单季“30-30”的小联盟捕手。

西瓦尼亚鹰 vs. 西巴奥巨人，美东时间下午4点三位百大潜力新秀构成了巨人的进攻核心，每位球员都拥有冬联中最具破坏力的棒子。Emil Morales（洛杉矶道奇第4号/大联盟第22号）、Roldy Brito（科罗拉多洛矶第2号/大联盟第52号）和Jefferson Rojas（纽约大都会第1号/大联盟第68号）都具备通过一次挥击就能重创棒球的能力。Morales是小联盟赛季中唯一一位轰出25支以上本垒打的十几岁游击手。

东方之星 vs. 东部多罗斯，美东时间下午4点东方之星的Leo Bernal（圣路易斯红雀第4号/大联盟第80号）在今年证明了他在精英级别没有什么做不到的事。在凭借防守能力崭露头角后，Bernal在一次24场比赛的大联盟短暂登场中交出了.807的攻击指数。东方之星的阵容还拥有Ronny Cruz（华盛顿国民第7号）。另一边，Justin Gonzales（波士顿红袜第2号/大联盟第71号）在高阶1A和2A之间展现了出色的力量，轰出19支本垒打并交出.834的攻击指数。

亚利桑那秋季联赛秋星赛，美东时间晚上8点第20届年度亚利桑那秋季联赛展示赛将汇聚来自29个组织的顶尖潜力新秀，上演一场星光熠熠的赛事。该阵容拥有10位来自 MLB Pipeline 的百大潜力新秀，包括 Sebastian Walcott（得克萨斯游骑兵第1号/大联盟第8号）、Arjun Nimmala（洛杉矶天使第1号/大联盟第34号）和 Aidan Miller（费城费城人第2号/大联盟第59号）。秋星赛分为美国联盟和国家联盟两支队伍，为球迷提供了一个绝佳的机会，去欣赏棒球界最优秀的年轻新秀们在沙漠中携手并进。了解更多 >>

items.titleEn: '27 Rookie of the Year candidates -- one from each team
bodyEn: Sometimes rookies can be seen a mile away and it's clear they will make a big splash once they hit the big leagues full time. Others can sneak up on you, flying under the radar until they're given the opportunity to show what they can do.

A year ago, we picked a 2026 Rookie of the Year candidate for each team. We nailed four of the six finalists when we named Kevin McGonigle and Payton Tolle in the AL along with Sal Stewart and JJ Wetherholt in the NL. And in the case of the other two, Parker Messick and Carson Benge, our selections -- Chase DeLauter and Nolan McLean -- certainly held up.
So pay close attention to the 30 names listed below. Chances are good that there will be some 2027 award winners from this group.
Jump to: AL East | AL Central | AL West | NL East | NL Central | NL West
AMERICAN LEAGUE EAST

Blue Jays: Nolan Perry, RHP (No. 2/MLB No. 90)A later-round high school pick in 2022 who had Tommy John surgery knock out his 2025 campaign, Perry has made just nine starts above A ball. But they were really good starts (2.32 ERA, .163 BAA, 1.03 WHIP) and he was much sharper overall post-TJ than expected. The gloves could come off and he could vault quickly into Toronto's rotation.

Orioles: Joseph Dzierwa, LHP (No. 3/MLB No. 69)The Orioles have some serious pitching depth on the way, with a trio of Top 100 arms having thrown very well at Double-A this past season. Dzierwa is the most advanced of that trio, coming off a year in which he posted a 2.27 combined ERA, .186 BAA and 0.90 WHIP to go along with a 149/30 K/BB ratio in 131 innings. He could get a chance to make the big league rotation early, and don't be surprised to see Anthony Eyanson and Caden Hunter join him in Baltimore at some point.

Rays: Caden Bodine, C (No. 3/MLB No. 46)The presence of Liam Hicks makes this a little tougher to lock down, but Bodine impressed everyone in the organization after coming over from the Orioles in the Shane Baz deal. The 2025 draftee went from Single-A to Triple-A in his first full season of pro ball, finishing with a combined .342/.410/.517 line. The Rays thought so highly of him that he was their emergency catcher on the taxi squad during their run to the World Series.

Red Sox: Franklin Arias, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 2)Trevor Story may have another year remaining on his $140 million contract, but Arias is a better offensive and defensive option right now. He won the Double-A Eastern League MVP and top prospect awards, climbed to Triple-A at age 20 and batted .323/.400/.557 with 25 homers in 117 games between the two levels. And to think that when he signed for $525,000 out of Venezuela in 2023, his glove was more valued than his bat.

Yankees: Carlos Lagrange, RHP (No. 3)Elmer Rodriguez might have been the choice if there were openings in New York's rotation, but Lagrange will have an easier time finding a bullpen role if he's fully recovered from a shoulder strain that prevented him from helping the Yankees this summer. He made headlines by striking out Aaron Judge with a 103-mph fastball during live batting practice in Spring Training, and his power secondary pitches (cutter, sweeper and changeup) also can be nasty when they're on. Signed for just $10,000 from the Dominican Republic in 2022, he logged a 4.48 ERA with 85 strikeouts in 64 1/3 Triple-A innings before he was sidelined.
AMERICAN LEAGUE CENTRAL

Guardians: Ralphy Velazquez, 1B/OF (No. 1/MLB No. 29)A 2023 first-rounder from a California high school who has blossomed into baseball's best first-base prospect, Velazquez can give Cleveland's offense a much-needed jolt with his ability to hit for average and power. He slashed .290/.379/.548 with 29 homers in 117 games between Double-A and Triple-A at age 21, leading the system in slugging.

Royals: Lucas Braun, RHP (No. 16)Braun's stuff is never going to wow anyone, but he's spent the past three years at the upper levels and is ready for a shot. He scuffled a bit after getting dealt from the Braves to the Royals at the Trade Deadline, but he’s been a very durable starter, topping 140 IP twice in the last two years (over 130 IP this past season) and could be a very solid inning-eating back-end starter in 2027.

Tigers: River Ryan, RHP (No. 3/MLB No. 64)Because Ryan has missed so much time with injuries, compiling just 69 1/3 combined innings over the past three years, making it exceedingly tricky to rank and project his future. But he finished the 2026 season with a healthy September, including a couple of big league outings, after coming to the Tigers from the Dodgers in Tarik Skubal deal. The stuff is still very real and he should have every chance to make a huge impact on Detroit's big league rotation out of the gate.

Twins: Walker Jenkins, OF (No. 1/MLB No. 13)Whenever Jenkins has been on the field, he's produced, and 2026 was no different for the 2023 No. 5 overall pick. Though he's yet to play more than 100 games in a season because of a myriad of injuries, he still reached the big leagues this year at age 21 after slashing .323/.417/.559 in 73 Minor League games before getting his feet wet over 26 games with Minnesota. He should be in the lineup from Opening Day on.

White Sox: Caleb Bonemer, 3B/SS (No. 2/MLB No. 27)Bonemer is on the verge of slugging his way into Chicago's lineup, and the White Sox had him play the outfield in the Arizona Fall League to give them more options to make that happen. A 2024 second-rounder from a Michigan high school, he topped the Minors with 69 extra-base hits and ranked fifth with 37 homers while hitting .251/.380/.550 with 17 steals in 132 games between High-A and Double-A at age 20. Besides his prowess at the plate, he also offers the ability to play shortstop, third base, the outfield corners and perhaps center field.
AMERICAN LEAGUE WEST

Angels: Tyler Bremner, RHP (No. 2/MLB No. 42)Outfielder Nelson Rada is on the cusp, and after seeing shortstop Arjun Nimmala in the Fall League, he could be an interesting candidate. But Bremner's stuff is so advanced and he was only slowed by illness and the ensuing fatigue during his first full season. He reached Double-A anyway, and a full offseason to work on strength could have him ready to jump into the Angels' rotation in a hurry.

Astros: Bryce Mayer, RHP (No. 8)A 16th-round pick out of Missouri in 2024, Mayer has won the Astros' Minor League pitcher of the year award in both of his two full seasons. He compiled a 3.53 ERA, .201 average-against and 140 strikeouts in 102 innings between Double-A and Triple-A in 2026, thanks mainly to 92-96 mph fastball with nifty carry and a low-80s slider with plenty of horizontal action.

A's: Leo De Vries, SS/3B (No. 1/MLB No. 3)Surgery to repair a torn labrum in his right shoulder makes this a bit of a gamble, but it's hard to look past the talent and the fact the A's don't shy away from pushing guys to the big leagues. He'll be age 20 for all of 2027 after posting an OPS of .836 with 13 homers and 34 steals in 93 Double-A games in his first full season with the A's organization. If the A's are worried about his arm, they can slide him to second base and can even keep veteran Jeff McNeil as a super-utility type.

Mariners: Kade Anderson, LHP (No. 1/MLB No. 5)It might be tougher to predict pitchers as ROY candidates, but Anderson is entering 2027 as a front-runner for the award. All the No. 3 overall pick in the 2025 Draft did was turn in one of the best Minor League performances in recent memory this season, earning Pitching Prospect of the Year honors in the process. He jumped from Double-A to the big leagues and made seven starts that showed he's more than ready for the assignment, capping things off with 10 1/3 scoreless innings over his last two outings.

Rangers: Sebastian Walcott, SS/3B (No. 1/MLB No. 8)Labeled the best Bahamian prospect ever when he signed for $3.2 million in 2023, Walcott was on course to claim a starting job in Texas this year before he had internal brace surgery on his throwing elbow in February. His prodigious power returned when he was able to DH in mid-July and he batted .325/.401/.590 with 10 homers in 41 games (mostly at Double-A). He's back to playing the field again in the Arizona Fall League and showing off his trademark arm strength.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
NATIONAL LEAGUE EAST

Braves: Patrick Clohisy, OF (No. 16)As a college senior taken in Round 11 of the 2024 Draft, Clohisy has largely flown under the radar, but that hasn't stopped him from loudly knocking on the big league door. The speedster has stolen 141 bags in his last two seasons and he hit .340/.420/.483 in 42 Triple-A games in 2026 to show he's ready to keep defying expectations.

Marlins: Cam Cannarella, OF (No. 5/MLB No. 77)Though Cannarella featured one of the best combinations of bat-to-ball skills, speed and center-field defense in the 2025 Draft, the Clemson star fell to pick No. 43 because of concerns about his offensive impact and his price tag. He has eased those by overcoming a non-displaced fracture of his right wrist to slash .324/.422/.512 with 15 homers and 21 steals in 98 games while rising from High-A to Triple-A. He may be Miami's best option for a leadoff man and center fielder next season.

Mets: Jonathan Santucci, LHP (No. 2)Top prospect Jefferson Rojas would be a good choice if the Mets' infield wasn't so crowded, so we'll look to the mound after Nolan McLean earned votes in 2026. Santucci led the Minors with 163 K's over 125 IP in his second full season after being the Mets' second-round pick in 2024. His eight Triple-A starts weren't great this past season, but he's the type of savvy lefty who will learn from that and carry those lessons to the big league rotation.

Nationals: Seaver King, SS/2B (No. 3/MLB No. 51)After the Nationals drafted King 10th overall out of Wake Forest in 2024, he struggled in his first full pro season because he mitigated his advanced bat-to-ball skills by chasing too many pitches. A more selective approach led to a .303/.382/.516 line with 21 homers and 15 steals in 112 games between Double-A and Triple-A this year. He also comes with well-above-average speed and looks to push CJ Abrams to second base on a full-time basis.

Phillies: Aidan Miller, SS/3B (No. 2/MLB No. 59)If Miller had been healthy in 2026, he might have graduated already. But he missed nearly all of the regular season with back issues, returning for just a handful of regular-season and playoff games in the Minors. He was sent to the Arizona Fall League for more reps, and to play third, and he looked very good doing both, hitting .320 with a .547 OBP and looking very healthy on both sides of the ball. He could very well be the Phillies' Opening Day third baseman in 2027.
NATIONAL LEAGUE CENTRAL

Brewers: Jesús Made, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 1)On one hand, the Brewers just won the World Series and have a deep, young lineup. On the other, Made is the game's top prospect and could shift from shortstop to third base, one of the weakest positions on Milwaukee's big league roster. A five-tool player signed for $950,000 out of the Dominican Republic in 2024, he hit .271/.344/.430 with 14 homers and 37 steals in 122 Double-A games at age 19, earning top prospect accolades in the Texas League.

Cardinals: Joshua Baéz, OF (No. 3/MLB No. 57)Fellow Top 100 Prospects Rainiel Rodriguez and Liam Doyle also have designs on winning jobs in St. Louis next season, but Baéz will have a more immediate opportunity. The first player ever to homer in his first three big league plate appearances, he fits the classic right-field profile with his plus power and arm strength, and he also runs well for a 6-foot-3, 220-pounder. Between Triple-A and the Majors, the 2021 second-rounder from a Massachusetts high school batted .251/.318/.561 with 41 homers and 23 steals in 132 games.

Cubs: Owen Ayers, C/1B (No. 2/MLB No. 88)Ayers' right-handed pop and strong arm make him an obvious replacement if Carson Kelly departs via free agency, and his ability to also play first base and maybe the outfield corners could help him find a role in Chicago even if Kelly returns. He went from 19th-rounder out of Marshall in 2024 to Top 100 prospect in two years, hitting .289/.403/.526 with 25 homers and 13 steals while advancing from High-A to Triple-A.

Pirates: Murf Gray, 3B (No. 4/MLB No. 89)Gray's path to a big league gig might be connected to whether the Pirates can bring Brandon Lowe back to play second base. If he leaves, Nick Gonzales could slide over to the keystone and Gray could get a long look, even though he's played just 45 games at Double-A in his career. If they really want to get the bat that slugged a combined .567 with 32 homers in his first full season to the big leagues faster, they could tell him to try out a first baseman's glove.

Reds: Carlos Jorge, OF (No. 15)He's not arriving with the fanfare of Sal Stewart, but Jorge shouldn't be overlooked. Originally a shortstop, Jorge has turned into one of the best defensive outfielders in the system, one who hit a combined .308/.376/.427 with 33 steals between Double-A and Triple-A before getting a late 18-game taste of big league life in September. He could have a path to becoming the Opening Day center fielder in Cincy.
NATIONAL LEAGUE WEST

Diamondbacks: Demetrio Crisantes, 2B (No. 1/MLB No. 84)Crisantes' advanced bat-to-ball skills and big league readiness will factor into whether or not Arizona decides to trade Ketel Marte this offseason. Drafted in 2022's seventh round from an Arizona high school, he slashed .292/.377/.477 with 10 homers in 92 games this year between four levels, seeing most of his action in Triple-A.

Dodgers: Josue De Paula, OF (No. 1/MLB No. 4)Los Angeles doesn't have an obvious spot in its lineup for De Paula, but he's the best offensive prospect in the game and did crack its postseason roster at age 21 after hitting .323/.500/.581 with a 416-foot homer in 31 big league at-bats. Signed for $397,500 out of the Dominican Republic in 2022, he won Texas League MVP honors after slashing .303/.401/.547 and topping the Double-A circuit in hits (152), doubles (37), runs (106) and RBIs (104).

Giants: Bo Davidson, OF (No. 8)San Francisco needs outfield help and Davidson can provide with the one best power/speed combinations in the system and a track record of production. Signed for $50,000 as a nondrafted free agent out of Caldwell (N.C.) CC in 2023, he batted .290/.361/.527 with 29 homers and 20 steals in 125 games between Double-A and Triple-A, then went 7-for-20 (.350) during a big league callup.

Padres: Ethan Salas, C (No. 1/MLB No. 21)The top prospect in the 2023 international class, Salas signed for $5.6 million and reached Double-A as a 17-year-old in his pro debut, then struggled with injuries and getting rushed the next two seasons. The athletic backstop rebounded in 2026, displaying offensive upside by slashing .296/.374/.448 with 10 homers and 17 steals in 96 games between Double-A and Triple-A, then going 10-for-39 (.256) with two homers as the youngest player (age 20) in the Majors this season. He also won the Minor League Defensive Player of the Year award and started two of San Diego's first three Division Series games.

Rockies: Charlie Condon, 1B/OF (No. 3/MLB No. 56)The Rockies' top pick (No. 3 overall) in 2024, Condon looked like he could be poised to make his big league debut during a bounceback season in 2026, though a dip in production in August might have given the club pause before he finished with a strong September in Triple-A. Overall, his .904 OPS and 27 homers show he has nothing left to prove and should get to show just how much his power will play in Coors Field in 2027, though it might have to come in the outfield with TJ Rumfield establishing himself at first base.
items.titleZh: 2027年最佳新秀候选：每支球队一人
items.summaryZh: 本文盘点了30支球队在2027赛季最具冲击最佳新秀奖潜力的年轻球员。
bodyZh: 有时新秀的崛起有迹可循，当他们正式升入大联盟后，人们会清楚地知道他们将掀起波澜。另一些人则会悄然登场，在获得展现身手的大好机会前不显山露水。
一年前，我们为每支球队挑选了一位2026年最佳新秀候选人。当我们提名美联的Kevin McGonigle和Payton Tolle，以及国联的Sal Stewart和JJ Wetherholt时，我们成功命中了六名决赛选手中的四位。至于另外两位Parker Messick和Carson Benge，我们的最初选择——Chase DeLauter和Nolan McLean——同样表现不俗。
因此，请密切关注下面列出的30个名字。这其中很有可能会诞生几位2027年的奖项得主。
跳转至：美联东区 | 美联中区 | 美联西区 | 国联东区 | 国联中区 | 国联西区
美国联盟东区
多伦多蓝鸟：Nolan Perry，右投（球队第2/大联盟第90）作为2022年选秀后段的高中新秀，Perry因接受Tommy John手术缺席了2025赛季，他在高级单A以上层级仅有9次先发。但这些先发表现极佳（自责分率2.32，对手打击率.163，WHIP 1.03），且他在手术后的整体表现远比预期更为锐利。球队可能会解除对他的保护，使他迅速跻身多伦多蓝鸟的先发轮值。

巴尔的摩金莺：Joseph Dzierwa，左投（球队第3/大联盟第69）巴尔的摩金莺正蓄积深厚的投篮深度，在过去这个赛季中，有三名百大新秀级别的投手在双A投得非常出色。Dzierwa是这三人中最成熟的一位，他刚刚度过了一个交出2.27综合自责分率、.186对手打击率和0.90 WHIP的赛季，并在131局投球中送出149次三振与30次保送。他可能会很早获得进入大联盟先发轮值的机会，同时看到Anthony Eyanson和Caden Hunter在某个时刻加入巴尔的摩金莺也不足为奇。

坦帕湾光芒：Caden Bodine，捕手（球队第3/大联盟第46）Liam Hicks的存在让这个位置的选择变得有些艰难，但在肖恩·巴兹（Shane Baz）的交易中从巴尔的摩金莺转投而来后，Bodine给整个球团留下了深刻印象。这位2025届选秀球员在他的职业生涯第一个完整赛季中，从单A一路升至三A，交出了.342/.410/.517的综合三围数据。坦帕湾光芒对他的评价极高，以至于在他们杀入世界大赛的征程中，他成为了候补名单上的紧急捕手。

波士顿红袜：Franklin Arias，游击手（球队第1/大联盟第2）Trevor Story的1.4亿美元合同可能还剩一年，但Arias目前来看是更好的进攻和防守选择。他赢得了双A东部联盟MVP和顶级新秀奖，在20岁时升入三A，并在两层级的117场比赛中打出.323/.400/.557的打击三围，外加25支本垒打。要知道，当他在2023年以52.5万美元从委内瑞拉签约时，人们对其手套的评价还要高于他的球棒。

纽约洋基：Carlos Lagrange，右投（球队第3）如果纽约洋基的轮值有空缺，Elmer Rodriguez本可能是个选择，但如果Lagrange已经从今年夏天阻碍他帮助纽约洋基的肩膀拉伤中完全康复，他将更容易在牛棚找到角色。他在春训的实战打击练习中用一记103英里/小时的直球三振亚伦·贾奇（Aaron Judge）而成为头条新闻，而他的强力变化球（卡特球、横扫球和变速球）在状态好时也同样犀利。2022年他以仅1万美元从多米尼加共和国签约，在进入伤病名单之前，他在三A投了64.1局，自责分率为4.48，并送出85次三振。
美国联盟中区
克利夫兰守护者：Ralphy Velazquez，一、外野手（球队第1/大联盟第29）作为2023年来自加州高中的首轮秀，Velazquez已经成长为棒球界最好的一垒潜力新秀，他凭借出色的打击率和长打能力，能为克利夫兰守护者的进攻注入亟需的活力。他在21岁时在双A和三A的117场比赛中打出.290/.379/.548的打击三围和29支本垒打，领跑整个体系的长打率。
堪萨斯城皇家：Lucas Braun，右投（球队第16）Braun的球路从不会惊艳任何人，但他已经在高阶小联盟度过了过去三年，并且已经准备好迎接机会。在交易截止日从亚特兰大勇士被交易到堪萨斯城皇家后，他有些挣扎，但他一直是一位非常耐投的先发投手，在过去两年中两次投球局数超过140局（上赛季超过130局），并可能在2027年成为一名非常稳健、能吃局数的后段先发投手。

底特律老虎：River Ryan，右投（球队第3/大联盟第64）由于Ryan因伤缺阵了很长时间，过去三年总共只投了69.1局，这使得对他的未来排名和预测变得极其棘手。但在塔里克·斯库贝尔（Tarik Skubal）的交易中从洛杉矶道奇来到底特律老虎后，他在健康的九月份结束了2026赛季，其中包括几次大联盟出场。他的球路依然货真价实，并且应该拥有绝佳的机会在开局就对底特律老虎的大联盟先发轮值产生巨大影响。

明尼苏达双城：Walker Jenkins，外野手（球队第1/大联盟第13）只要Jenkins踏上球场，他就能产出惊艳表现，2023年这位全美第5顺位新秀在2026年也是如此。尽管由于各种伤病，他从未在一个赛季中出场超过100场，但他在小联盟73场比赛中交出.323/.417/.559的打击三围后，今年仍在21岁时升入大联盟，并在明尼苏达双城完成了26场比赛的初体验。他应该从揭幕战起就进入首发阵容。

芝加哥白袜：Caleb Bonemer，三、游击手（球队第2/大联盟第27）Bonemer正处于用长打敲开芝加哥白袜首发阵容的边缘，芝加哥白袜让他在亚利桑那秋季联盟中防守外野，以提供更多实现这一目标的可能性。作为2024届来自密歇根州高中的二轮秀，他在20岁时于高阶单A和双A的132场比赛中，以.251/.380/.550的打击率、17次盗垒领跑小联盟，长打数达到69个，本垒打数排名第五。除了在打击区上的威风八面外，他还能够胜任游击手、三垒手、外野两翼，或许还有中外野的防守。
美国联盟西区
洛杉矶天使：Tyler Bremner，右投（球队第2/大联盟第42）外野手Nelson Rada正迫近大联盟，在秋季联盟看到游击手Arjun Nimmala后，他可能也是一个有趣的候选人。但Bremner的球路非常成熟，他在首个完整赛季中仅仅受到疾病和随之而来的疲劳所拖累。无论如何他还是升上了双A，而一个完整的休赛期力量训练可能会让他准备好迅速跃入洛杉矶天使的先发轮值。
休斯敦太空人：Bryce Mayer，右投（球队第8）作为2024年第16轮选秀从密苏里大学选中的球员，Mayer在他出战的两个完整赛季中都赢得了休斯敦太空人的小联盟年度最佳投手奖。2026年，他在双A和三A的102局投球中交出3.53的自责分率、.201的对手打击率和140次三振，这主要归功于他92-96英里/小时、带有不错上飘尾劲的直球，以及球速在80英里/小时出头、具有充足横向位移的滑球。

运动家：Leo De Vries，游击、三垒手（球队第1/大联盟第3）修复右肩关节唇撕裂的手术让这笔投资带有一点冒险性质，但很难忽视他的天赋以及运动家从不畏惧将年轻人推上大联盟的事实。在运动家球团的第一个完整赛季中，他在双A出战93场，交出.836的OPS，外加13支本垒打和34次盗垒，他将在整个2027赛季保持20岁。如果运动家对他的手臂感到担忧，他们可以把他移到二垒，甚至可以继续将老将Jeff McNeil作为超级多功能球员使用。

西关水手：Kade Anderson，左投（球队第1/大联盟第5）预测投手作为年度最佳新秀候选人可能会更难，但Anderson以领跑者的姿态进入2027赛季。这位2025年选秀大会上的全体第3顺位新秀本赛季交出了近年来小联盟最出色的投球表现之一，并在此过程中赢得了年度最佳投球新秀荣誉。他从双A直接跃升至大联盟，并进行了7次先发，展现出他已完全准备好迎接任务，并在最后两次出场中以连续10.1局无失分画上句号。

得克萨斯游骑兵：Sebastian Walcott，游击、三垒手（球队第1/大联盟第8）2023年以320万美元签约时，Walcott被贴上了有史以来最佳巴哈马新秀的标签，如果不是因为他在2月份对投球手肘进行了内支具手术，他本有望在今年争得得克萨斯游骑兵的主力位置。他在7月中旬能够担任指定打击时，其惊人的长打能力便回归了，在41场比赛中（大部分在双A）打出.325/.401/.590的打击三围外加10支本垒打。他目前已在亚利桑那秋季联盟重返防守位置，并展示了他标志性的臂力。
订阅 MLB Pipeline 通讯
国家联盟东区
亚特兰大勇士：Patrick Clohisy，外野手（球队第16）作为2024年选秀第11轮被选中的大学应届毕业生，Clohisy在很大程度上一直不引人注目，但这并没有阻止他有力地敲开大联盟的大门。这位速度型球员在过去两个赛季中盗取了141个垒包，并在2026年的42场三项赛（三A）比赛中交出.340/.420/.483的打击三围，证明他准备好继续打破预期。

迈阿密马林鱼：Cam Cannarella，外野手（球队第5/大联盟第77）尽管Cannarella拥有2025届选秀中最出色的击球技巧、速度和中外野防守组合之一，但这位克莱姆森大学的明星由于外界对其进攻潜力和身价的担忧而跌至第43顺位。他克服了右腕无移位骨折的伤势，从高阶单A一路升至三A，在98场比赛中交出.324/.422/.512的打击三围，外加15支本垒打和21次盗垒，从而打消了这些顾虑。他可能是迈阿密马林鱼下赛季担任开路先锋和中外野手的最佳选择。

纽约大都会：Jonathan Santucci，左投（球队第2）如果纽约大都会的内野不是那么拥挤，顶级新秀Jefferson Rojas会是个好选择，因此在Nolan McLean于2026年赢得选票后，我们将目光投向投手丘。在成为纽约大都会2024年二轮秀后的第二个完整赛季中，Santucci在125局投球中送出163次三振，领跑小联盟。他过去这个赛季的8次三巷（三A）先发表现不算太好，但他正是那种会从中吸取教训并将这些经验带到大联盟轮值中的精明左投。

华盛顿国民：Seaver King，游击、二垒手（球队第3/大联盟第51）在华盛顿国民于2024年从维克森林大学以第10顺位选秀权选中King之后，他在职业生涯的第一个完整赛季中表现挣扎，因为他由于追打太多坏球而削弱了自己高超的击球技巧。更加挑剔的选球策略让他今年在双A和三A的112场比赛中交出.303/.382/.516的打击三围，外加21支本垒打和15次盗垒。他还拥有远超平均的速度，并期望能全职逼迫CJ Abrams移防二垒。

费城费城人：Aidan Miller，游击、三垒手（球队第2/大联盟第59）如果Miller在2026年保持健康，他可能已经毕业了。但他因背部问题缺席了几乎整个常规赛季，仅在小联盟的常规赛和季后赛中出场了寥寥数场。他被派往亚利桑那秋季联盟以获得更多打席并防守三垒，他在攻守两端都表现得非常出色，打击率为.320，上垒率高达.547，并且在攻防两端都显得非常健康。他很有可能成为费城费城人2027年开幕战的三垒手。
国家联盟中区

密尔沃基酿酒人：Jesús Made，游击手（球队第1/大联盟第1）一方面，密尔沃基酿酒刚刚赢得了世界大赛，并拥有一套深度十足的年轻阵容。另一方面，Made是比赛中排名第一的顶级新秀，并且可以从游击手转为三垒手——这是密尔沃基酿酒人大联盟名单上最薄弱的位置之一。这位2024年以95万美元从多米尼加共和国签约的五拍子球员，在19岁时于双A的122场比赛中打出.271/.344/.430的打击三围，有14支本垒打和37次盗垒，赢得了得克萨斯联盟顶级新秀的赞誉。

圣路易斯红雀：Joshua Baéz，外野手（球队第3/大联盟第57）同为百大新秀的Rainiel Rodriguez和Liam Doyle也对下赛季在圣路易斯赢得工作虎视眈眈，但Baéz将拥有更直接的机会。作为历史上首位在前三次大联盟打击机会中都击出本垒打的球员，他凭借出色的长力和臂力完美契合了经典的右外野手模版，对于一个身高6尺3寸、体重220磅的球员来说，他的奔跑速度也很不错。在三A和大联盟之间，这位2021年从马萨诸塞州高中选出的二轮秀在132场比赛中打出.251/.318/.561的打击三围，有41支本垒打和23次盗垒。

芝加哥小熊：Owen Ayers，捕手、一垒手（球队第2/大联盟第88）Ayers的右手重炮和强壮臂力使他成为如果Carson Kelly通过自由球员离开时的绝佳替身，而他能够防守一垒甚至可能防守外野两翼的能力，也能帮助他在Kelly回归的情况下在芝加哥找到一席之地。他在两年内从2024年马歇尔大学的第19轮新秀一跃成为百大新秀，在从高阶单A升至三A的过程中，交出.289/.403/.526的打击三围，伴随25支本垒打和13次盗垒。

匹兹堡海盗：Murf Gray，三垒手（球队第4/大联盟第89）Gray通往大联盟的道路可能与匹兹堡海盗能否迎回Brandon Lowe防守二垒息息相关。如果Lowe离队，Nick Gonzales可以移防关键二垒，而Gray则可能获得长期的考察机会，尽管他在职业生涯中仅在双A出场过45场比赛。如果他们真的想让这位在职业生涯第一个完整赛季中综合长打率达到.567并轰出32支本垒打的强打者更快地升入大联盟，他们可以告诉他去试着戴上一垒手套。
辛辛那提红人：Carlos Jorge，外野手（球队第15）他不像Sal Stewart那样伴随着狂热造势到来，但Jorge不应被忽视。原本是游击手的Jorge已经转型为体系中最优秀的外野防守球员之一，在9月份短暂获得18场大联盟比赛体验之前，他在双A和三A交出了.308/.376/.427的综合打击率和33次盗垒。他可能拥有在辛辛那提成为开幕战中外野手的通路。
国家联盟西区
亚利桑那响尾蛇：Demetrio Crisantes，二垒手（球队第1/大联盟第84）Crisantes高超的击球技巧和大联盟成熟度将成为亚利桑那响尾蛇决定是否在这个休赛期交易Ketel Marte的考量因素之一。作为2022年从亚利桑那高中在第7轮被选中的球员，他今年在四个层级的92场比赛中交出.292/.377/.477的打击三围，伴有10支本垒打，其中大部分出赛都在三A。

洛杉矶道奇：Josue De Paula，外野手（球队第1/大联盟第4）洛杉矶道奇的阵容中并没有给De Paula留下一个显眼的位置，但他却是比赛中最顶级的进攻新秀，在31个大联盟打数中打出.323/.500/.581的打击率外加一记416英尺的本垒打后，他确实在21岁时挤进了季后赛名单。2022年他以39.75万美元从多米尼加共和国签约，在交出.303/.401/.547的打击三围并领跑双A巡回赛的安打（152）、二垒安打（37）、得分（106）和打点（104）后，他赢得了得克萨斯联盟MVP荣誉。
旧金山巨人：Bo Davidson，外野手（球队第8）旧金山巨人需要外野支援，而Davidson能够提供体系中最佳的力量与速度组合之一以及稳定的产出记录。2023年他以无选秀资格自由球员身份从考德威尔社区学院（北卡罗来纳州）以5万美元签约，在双A和三A的125场比赛中打出.290/.361/.527的打击率，有29支本垒打和20次盗垒，随后在大联盟征召期间20打数7安打（打击率.350）。

圣迭戈教士：Ethan Salas，捕手（球队第1/大联盟第21）作为2023年国际球员签约市场上的顶级新秀，Salas以560万美元签约，并在职业首秀时以17岁之龄升至双A，但在接下来的两个赛季中，他与伤病以及过早被拔苗助长做了斗争。这位运动能力出色的本垒后防球员在2026年强势反弹，在双A和三A的96场比赛中交出.296/.374/.448的打击三围，外加10支本垒打和17次盗垒，展现出进攻爆发力；随后作为本赛季大联盟最年轻的球员（20岁），他在季后赛中交出39打数10安打（.256）外加2支本垒打的成绩。他还赢得了小联盟年度最佳防守球员奖，并在圣迭戈教士前三场分区赛中的两场担任首发。

科罗拉多洛矶：Charlie Condon，一、外野手（球队第3/大联盟第56）作为科罗拉多洛矶在2024年的首轮秀（全美第3顺位），Condon在2026年的反弹赛季中看起来似乎准备好了上演大联盟首秀，尽管8月份产出的下滑可能让球队在他在三A以强势的九月份收官之前有所顾虑。总体而言，他.904的OPS和27支本垒打表明他已经没有什么需要证明的了，并应该在2027年展现他的强大力量能在库尔斯球场（Coors Field）带来多大的威力，尽管这可能不得不以外野手的身份实现，因为TJ Rumfield已经在球队的一垒位置上站稳了脚跟。

items.titleEn: Could Blue Jays search for upgrade at 2B over Clement?
bodyEn: TORONTO -- As the Blue Jays try to inject life into baseball’s lowest-scoring offense, some uncomfortable conversations are needed.

The easy ones are obvious. This team needs power, preferably in the form of a star outfielder, and the rotation could use another sturdy veteran, too. Those are just your annual, run-of-the-mill needs, though. The Blue Jays need to dig deeper than that, into the core of this roster.

That conversation keeps landing on second base, where Ernie Clement looked spectacular for the first four months of the season (.738 OPS), but faded from Aug. 1 on (.442 OPS). Vladimir Guerrero Jr. isn’t going anywhere, Andrés Giménez is too valuable defensively, Kazuma Okamoto is a necessary power threat and their catching tandem is truly great, so in the simplest of terms, second base is what’s left.
The big question: Is Ernie Clement the starter at 2B?

By August and September, Clement was worn out. He’ll be the last person to say that out loud, but even manager John Schneider wondered aloud, late in the year, if he should have given Clement more off-days down the stretch. Clement’s playing style, coming off a deep World Series run in 2025 and a World Baseball Classic in early ‘26, would wear out anyone.
The first question, then, is whether Clement walks into next season as the starter.

“He’s got to earn every bit of that,” general manager Ross Atkins said. “It’s not just writing down, ‘OK, we’re covered,’ but he always has [earned it]. When he’s been given an opportunity, he’s run with it. We’re always trying to complement every player the best that we can. Ernie can be an everyday, impactful player. He can also be a player who plays [most] games and plays at a really high level, and because we’re such a good team, he isn’t the guy that’s being penciled in every day.”
Perhaps that question is too narrow, though.

We know that Clement can play every spot on the infield, and while his experience in the corner outfields is fairly limited as a pro, he’s the type of athlete worth betting on in “new” spots. If Clement were to slide into a superutility role, that would allow Schneider to rotate the DH job, which the Blue Jays are eager to do. Okamoto and Guerrero, in particular, could benefit from this.

The “starting second baseman” tag feels too rigid here, and if that isn’t Clement going into 2027, that’s no knock on him. There would still be a pathway for him to appear in 125-plus games, and if that allows the Blue Jays to chase an offensive upgrade, it’s just another way for Clement to show his unique value to this organization.
Which free agents would be worth this conversation?
A theory: If Jazz Chisholm Jr. were entering free agency as a Marlin, not a Yankee, Blue Jays fans would be much more attracted to the idea.

The 28-year-old Chisholm is coming off a down year offensively after a 30-30 season in 2025 with the Yankees, but his appeal to the Blue Jays should be obvious here, especially given the likelihood he could sign a short-term deal and try to re-enter free agency around his age 30-31 season.

In 2027, the Blue Jays plan to obsess over baserunning, which is one of Chisholm’s trademarks. Elite baserunning and above-average defense are a great starting point -- and a very “Blue Jays” profile -- so it’s all about whether Chisholm could recapture his power upside. If the Blue Jays believe that answer is “yes,” Chisholm represents the exact type of player worth shaking up the infield for.
Another small factor worth mentioning: Schneider handles big personalities well. It’s easy to envision Chisholm thriving in that environment.

Brandon Lowe represents another option, coming off a peak season at 32. After back-to-back seasons with 30-plus homers, the power is clearly there. The real head-scratcher is how Lowe’s defense swung from being very poor to being truly exceptional last season, so the Blue Jays would need to factor in how they project that into Lowe’s mid-30s.

Further down the list, you’ll find Gleyber Torres, who is coming off a down year with just eight homers and a .727 OPS over 96 games with the Tigers. Torres will be 30 when next season begins, but at this point, with negative baserunning value and average defense at best, is this a player worth disrupting Clement for?

This is about the big picture, not a simple “yes” or “no” call with Clement starting at second. Any success this team has in 2027, he’ll be part of, but that could take on a different look that we’re used to.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟会寻找二垒手升级人选以取代Clement吗？
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟正考虑是否在二垒位置上寻求升级，以改善球队进攻，而Ernie Clement的角色可能会发生变化。
bodyZh: 多伦多——随着多伦多蓝鸟试图为全大联盟得分最低的进攻端注入活力，一些艰难的对话在所难免。
显而易见的选择不言而喻。这支球队需要长打火力，最好是一名明星外野手，而先发轮值也需要另一位稳健的老将。不过，这些只是每年例行的常规需求。多伦多蓝鸟需要进行更深入的探讨，触及这套阵容的核心。
这种讨论不断聚焦于二垒位置，Ernie Clement在赛季的前四个月里表现惊艳（攻击指数.738），但从8月1日起状态下滑（攻击指数.442）。Vladimir Guerrero Jr.不会离开，Andrés Giménez的防守价值极高，Kazuma Okamoto是不可或缺的长打威胁，而他们的捕手搭档也确实非常出色，因此简而言之，剩下的就是二垒了。
最大的问题是：Ernie Clement是二垒的先发球员吗？
到了8月和9月，Clement已经筋疲力尽。他是最不会大声说出这一点的人，但就连总教练John Schneider在年末时也公开琢磨，自己是否应该在赛季冲刺阶段给Clement更多的休息日。经历了2025年漫长的世界大赛征程以及26年初的世界棒球经典赛后，Clement的比赛风格会让任何人感到疲惫。
那么，第一个问题就是Clement是否会作为先发球员进入下个赛季。
“他必须靠实力赢得这一切，”总经理Ross Atkins表示。“这不仅仅是在纸上写着‘好吧，我们这个位置有人了’，但他总是能做到。当他获得机会时，他总是能把握住。我们一直在尽最大努力为每一位球员进行补充。Ernie可以成为一名每天都能发挥影响力的球员。他也可以成为一名出场绝大多数比赛并保持极高水准的球员，而且因为我们是一支如此优秀的球队，他不会是那种每天名字都被写进先发名单的人。”
不过，也许这个问题有些过于狭隘了。
我们知道Clement可以守内野的每一个位置，虽然他在职业生涯中防守角落外野的经验相当有限，但他是一名值得在“新”位置上对其下注的运动员。如果Clement转入超级替补角色，这将使Schneider能够轮换指定打击的位置，多伦多蓝鸟非常渴望这样做。特别是Okamoto和Guerrero可以从中受益。
在这里，“先发二垒手”这个标签显得过于僵化，如果2027年不是Clement担任此职，这也绝不是对他的否定。他仍然有途径出场125场以上的比赛，如果这能让多伦多蓝鸟去追逐进攻端升级，这只是Clement向这支球队展示其独特价值的另一种方式。
哪些自由球员值得进行这样的讨论？
一个设想：如果Jazz Chisholm Jr.是以马林鱼球员而非洋基球员的身份进入自由球员市场，多伦多蓝鸟的球迷会对这个想法感兴趣得多。
现年28岁的Chisholm在2025年随洋基打出30轰30盗的赛季后，进攻端遭遇了低迷的一年，但他对多伦多蓝鸟的吸引力在这里应该很明显，特别是考虑到他很可能签下一份短合同，并试图在30岁到31岁左右再次进入自由球员市场。
在2027年，多伦多蓝鸟计划专注于跑垒，这也是Chisholm的标志之一。顶级的跑垒和高于平均水平的防守是一个很好的起点——也是非常“多伦多蓝鸟”式的球员轮廓——所以关键在于Chisholm能否找回他的长打潜力。如果多伦多蓝鸟认为答案是“肯定的”，那么Chisholm正是那种值得为之打乱内野配置的球员。
另一个值得一提的小因素：Schneider很擅长处理个性鲜明的球员。不难想象Chisholm能在那种环境中如鱼得水。
Brandon Lowe代表了另一种选择，他在32岁时迎来了巅峰赛季。在连续两个赛季轰出30多支本垒打后，他的长打能力显而易见。真正令人摸不透的是Lowe的防守在上赛季如何从非常糟糕一跃变为真正卓越的，因此多伦多蓝鸟需要将他们对Lowe三十岁中期的表现预测纳入考量。
在名单的更下方，你会发现Gleyber Torres，他在老虎队度过了一个低迷的赛季，在96场比赛中仅有8支本垒打，攻击指数为.727。当新赛季开始时Torres将年满30岁，但在目前跑垒价值为负、防守充其量只能算平均水平的情况下，这是一个值得让Clement做出牺牲去替换的球员吗？
这关乎大局，而不是对Clement是否先发二垒做出简单的“是”或“否”的决定。这支球队在2027年取得的任何成功，他都会是其中的一部分，但这可能会呈现出一种与我们习惯的不同面貌。

items.titleEn: Here's how every prospect fared in the AFL Fall Stars Game
bodyEn: SCOTTSDALE, Ariz. -- The 20th annual Fall Stars Game is in the books and it was a tightly contested showdown indicative of the considerable talent on both the American League and National League rosters.
It was an eighth-inning breakout from the NL squad that firmly swung the pendulum its way en route to a 7-4 win at Salt River Fields at Talking Stick. It was the NL's first victory since 2022.​
Reds outfielder Yerlin Confidan was named the game’s MVP, joining notable previous winners like Colson Montgomery (2023), JJ Bleday (2021), Royce Lewis (2019) and Gary Sánchez (2015).
Ten members of MLB Pipeline’s Top 100 Prospects list took the field and many showed off why they could soon be integral pieces of their respective franchises at the big league level.
All told, 60 players got into the game -- here’s how they did.
Jump to: AL East | AL Central | AL West | NL East | NL Central | NL West
AMERICAN LEAGUE EAST

Blue JaysJake Bloss, RHP (No. 11): The results weren't ideal -- two runs on two hits and a walk -- across Bloss' two-thirds of work, but the pure stuff was. His fastball topped out at 98.2 mph and he got whiffs on five of 11 swings.

Jake Cook, OF (No. 20): Arguably the fastest player in the Fall League, Cook fittingly entered as a pinch-runner in the sixth, taking over in right field the rest of the way. He went down looking on strikes in his lone trip to the box.

Aaron Parker, C: Less than 24 hours after putting on an epic Home Run Derby performance, Parker drew the start at designated hitter. The 5-foot-7 catcher (who is seeing most of his time in left field in the AFL) struck out twice and walked once, plating a run due to his plate discipline.

OriolesIke Irish, OF/1B (No. 5/MLB No. 95): It was a busy night for Irish, who walked, collected an infield RBI single and reached on an error in his three plate appearances. He drew the start in right field and unleashed a 94.5 mph throw to keep a runner at bay, a mark that would rank among MLB's 99th percentile in arm strength this year.

Patrick Reilly, RHP: The right-hander earned the start for the AL and battled his command, walking the first three batters he faced before rebounding to collect a pair of strikeouts to limit the damage to just one run. His four-seam fastball averaged 96.2 mph with a near-elite 19 inches of induced vertical break.

Braxton Bragg, RHP (No. 22): It was a dominant 10-pitch frame for the 2023 eighth-rounder, who struck out the first two batters he faced -- one on a cutter looking, the other on a sinker swinging -- before getting a quick groundout to cap off his night.

Vance Honeycutt, OF: One of the circuit's most tooled-up players was rewarded for his strong fall with the start in center field. The club's first-round pick in the 2024 Draft struck out twice and drew a walk in his three trips to the dish.

RaysNathan Flewelling, C (No. 4/MLB No. 63): Getting the start behind the dish, the All-Star Futures Game MVP went 0-for-3 but did rip a 101 mph liner to left field that was corralled in the third. He threw out an attempted basestealer in the first and then unleashed an 83.9 mph throw (equivalent to MLB's 95th percentile this year) on an erased stolen-base attempt in the fourth.

Marcus Johnson, RHP: The 6-foot-6 right-hander utilized his five-pitch mix to twirl a scoreless fifth inning, including a strikeout of Top 100 prospect Tate Southisene. He pounded the zone with 17 of his 23 pitches going for strikes, working around a pair of singles by getting his final two batters to fly out.

Red SoxAntonio Anderson, 1B/3B: The switch-hitting corner infielder showed off his power bona fides during the Home Run Derby on Saturday and then collected an opposite-field knock off Top 100 prospect Jarlin Susana in the first. He flipped around to the right-handed batter's box and struck out in his next two at-bats.

YankeesDax Kilby, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 78): A jam-packed AL infield led to Kilby entering at DH as a late-inning replacement. The club's 2025 first-round pick struck out swinging twice against a pair of right-handers.

Chris Veach, RHP: It was a quick night of work for the nondrafted free agent, who threw three pitches and retired the only batter he faced on a popup. He threw two mid-70s changeups that averaged an exceptional 48 inches of drop.
Kyle West, 1B: Tied for the Fall League lead with six homers entering the weekend, West entered the game at first base and struck out swinging in both of his trips to the plate.
AMERICAN LEAGUE CENTRAL

GuardiansLuke Hill, 2B (No. 15): Hill entered as a defensive replacement and made his offensive opportunities count. He walked in the seventh and smacked a double in the ninth en route to scoring the final AL run of the game. He did allow an NL run to score in the ninth on a throwing error.

Welbyn Francisca, SS (No. 19): The Fall League's OPS leader (1.198) went 1-for-3 at the plate with a single, a stolen base and a run scored. He saw time at both middle infield spots, making two sparkling plays in the field but also a costly throwing error at second base that allowed two runs to score for the NL in the fifth.

RoyalsAngeibel Gomez, OF (No. 2/MLB No. 76): Gomez entered in place of his Royals organization teammate (Zion Rose) and played left field. He struck out in both of his at-bats, though he's hit .293 so far in Fall League action.
Zion Rose, OF (No. 6): Rose led off for the AL in left field. He walked and had a pair of strikeouts in his trips to the plate. He also got picked off following a third-inning walk.
Justin Lamkin, LHP (No. 8): Lamkin wasted little time authoring a 1-2-3 inning. He threw six of just seven pitches for strikes with a max fastball velocity of 94.4 mph.
TigersNo active participants

TwinsKyle DeBarge, UTIL: DeBarge reached base three times with a double (104.4 mph exit velocity), a single and a walk. He also stole a pair of bases and manufactured a run by forcing an overthrow and scoring on the play in the fifth.

White SoxJonathan Clark, RHP: Clark entered in the eighth and got a strikeout on a changeup to end the frame. He returned to the mound in the bottom of the ninth and allowed a single to Alex McCoy before being lifted for Kenya Huggins.
AMERICAN LEAGUE WEST

AngelsArjun Nimmala, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 34): In the threads he received at the Trade Deadline after being dealt by the Blue Jays, Nimmala came off the bench to play shortstop. The 2023 first-rounder worked two five-pitch at-bats, but he struck out in both.

AstrosJank Pichardo, RHP: After being roughed up in his most recent AFL start, Pichardo tossed a scoreless inning of relief. The 22-year-old yielded a 103.6 mph single off the bat of Andy Perez with one out before generating a double play from Alex McCoy to close the frame.
AthleticsDavis Diaz, C/INF (No. 19): A sixth-inning substitution, Diaz lined a single at 99.8 mph before being caught stealing second base in his lone plate appearance.

Kenya Huggins, RHP (No. 23): The final pitcher to appear for the AL, Huggins emerged with the fate of the game already determined. The 23-year-old surrendered a softly hit single that plated a run before ending the game with a flyout and a popout.

MarinersAdam Smith, RHP: Smith took the loss after giving up three runs on four hits and a walk. The 26-year-old grabbed a couple of outs on a double play before getting the hook after 21 pitches, 10 for strikes.

RangersSebastian Walcott, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 8): After simmering at Double-A and Triple-A to close out an abbreviated regular season, Walcott has remained hot this fall. But while splitting time at shortstop and third base in the Fall Stars Game, the 20-year-old rocketed one of his two flyouts 386 feet at 94.5 mph. He also grounded out once.
Paxton Kling, OF (No. 20): Following his entry in the sixth, Kling made some solid contact when he was at the plate. He lined out in the seventh and then singled in a run in the ninth.
Julian Brock, C: Brock walked in his lone plate appearance, winning a six-pitch battle at the dish before being stranded at third base.

Alejandro Chiquillo, RHP: After generating two outs in play on his first eight pitches, Chiquillo yielded a 371-foot double to Yerlin Confidan on a changeup low in the zone. With a runner in scoring position, the 23-year-old closed the inning unscathed on Dillon Lewis' loud lineout.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
NATIONAL LEAGUE EAST

BravesTate Southisene, SS/2B (No. 3/MLB No. 58): The 20-year-old standout walked in the first and came around to score before striking out in his next two plate appearances. He also recorded a pair of outs defensively while drawing the start at shortstop for the NL squad.

Briggs McKenzie, LHP (No. 8): Equipped with some of the most electric stuff in the Fall League, McKenzie had difficulty corraling it during his appearance, allowing two runs on three hits and three walks. He got whiffs on two of his five sliders, maxing out at 3,033 RPMs.

MarlinsDillon Lewis, OF (No. 11): The box score showed an 0-for-2 from the right-handed hitter, but both outs were scorched -- a 99.9 mph lineout to left in the sixth and a 96.5 mph groundout (into a double play) in the eighth. He also tracked down the farthest hit ball of the night while patrolling center field, a 386-foot flyout by Sebastian Walcott.

MetsIrving Cota, RHP: After an error and fielder's choice put him in a bind in the sixth, Cota got a flyout and pair of strikeouts against three consecutive Top 100 prospects to escape the sixth unscathed. One of the Fall League's best relievers this year, he leaned heavily on his sinker/slider combo before going to his four-seamer and curveball for his K's.
Ryan Lambert, RHP: The third-hardest-throwing hurler in the game, Lambert topped out at 98.3 mph while striking out a batter and walking another. He threw nine heaters and averaged 97 mph.

NationalsJarlin Susana, RHP (No. 4/MLB No. 66): One of Minor League Baseball's preeminent flamethrowers brought the velo in spades, exceeding 102 mph five times during a scoreless frame. The 22-year-old struck out a pair of batters -- both looking against his mid-80s sweeper.

Teo Banks, OF: A breakout run through the Fall League earned Banks the starting right-field gig for the NL squad. The 2024 18th-rounder popped out in the second and was plunked by a pitch in the fourth.

Kevin Bazzell, C: He may not have entered until the seventh, but the 2024 third-rounder made a huge impact once he was on the field. Bazzell threw out an attempted basestealer in the eighth to preserve a tie then ripped a 100.3 mph double and scored the go-ahead run in the bottom half of the frame. He capped his night by drawing a walk in the ninth.

PhilliesAidan Miller, 3B/SS (No. 2/MLB No. 59): One of just two NL hitters to collect multiple hits (along with organization mate Luke Davis), Miller ripped a single off a 98.2 mph fastball before coming around to score in the fourth and then collected an infield knock a frame later.
Luke Davis, C: Ranked second in the AFL in on-base percentage (.537, trailing only Miller), Davis also enjoyed a two-hit night -- a 100.3 mph single in the eighth and an infield knock in the ninth.
NATIONAL LEAGUE CENTRAL

BrewersEric Bitonti, 1B/3B (No. 26): Bitonti had an eventful trip around the bases in the fourth. He earned his way on with a walk via an ABS challenge. He advanced on a wild pitch and came around to score on Carlos Sanchez's single. Bitonti played five innings as the NL's starting first baseman.
Matthew Wood, C: Wood took over catching duties in the fourth and logged three innings behind the plate. He flew out in his two at-bats.

CardinalsTai Peete, OF (No. 17): Fresh off reaching the finals of the Home Run Derby on Saturday, Peete went 0-for-2. He did work a nine-pitch walk in the first inning and showed off his 60-grade speed with a stolen base. He attempted to swipe third as well, but Nathan Flewelling threw him out to end the frame.
CubsKade Snell, OF: Snell entered as a defensive replacement in left field and went 1-for-3 at the dish. He popped out to third base to wrap up the Fall Stars Game.
PiratesWyatt Sanford, SS/2B (No. 5): Sanford came into the game as a defensive replacement at shortstop. The Pirates prospect went 0-for-2 at the plate with a strikeout.
Bryan Mena, RHP: Mena entered in the ninth with one out and allowed an inherited run on Paxton Kling's single. Mena utilized his offspeed arsenal to pick up two strikeouts as well.
RedsCarlos Sanchez, 3B/SS/OF (No. 14): Sanchez singled in a run before swiping second base in the fourth. The 21-year-old third baseman also showed some pop with a 101.5 mph lineout in the second.

Yerlin Confidan, OF: Already opening eyes during his Fall League campaign, Confidan earned Most Valuable Player honors after impressing with a 371-foot double to center field at 97.9 mph off the bat in the sixth and an RBI on a bases-loaded walk in the eighth.

Luke Holman, RHP: Holman struck out a pair of hitters in his inning of work. He ran his fastball up to 94 mph and generated six swings-and-misses on 23 pitches. Holman got swinging strikeouts from AFL Home Run Derby champion Aaron Parker and 2026 All-Star Futures Game MVP Nathan Flewelling.
NATIONAL LEAGUE WEST

D-backsDemetrio Crisantes, 2B (No. 1/MLB No. 84): After having limited playing time this past season while recovering from a shoulder injury, Crisantes has been putting his tools on full display in the Fall League and he rocketed a fifth-inning single at 103.5 mph. The 22-year-old also walked and grounded out.

Joe Ariola, LHP: Ariola was tasked with getting two outs in the eighth with a runner stood on first. The 22-year-old gave up a sharply hit single up the middle before Bazzell threw out a runner. The southpaw then fanned Angeibel Gomez on three pitches -- including an 81.3 mph curveball in the dirt -- to strand the runner at third.

DodgersBrooks Auger, RHP (No. 28): After losing a six-pitch battle to Hill to open the seventh with a walk, the 25-year-old struck out two batters and generated five swings-and-misses while retiring the next three batters in order.

Luke Fox, LHP: Fox surrendered a double to Kyle DeBarge on his third pitch of the game in the fifth. DeBarge stole third and scampered home on a throwing error by Fox. Los Angeles' southpaw hunkered down to strike out the side on 14 pitches.
GiantsDalton Wentz, 3B: Wentz was the lone National League position player not to appear in the game.

PadresKannon Kemp, RHP (No. 13): Kemp came in with the bases loaded and two outs, and he yielded a loud and deep flyout from Nathan Flewelling. The 22-year-old took turned in a perfect fourth, striking out Zion Rose with a slider in a seven-pitch battle. The 2023 eighth-rounder touched 99.3 mph and generated three whiffs on eight swings.
Alex McCoy, OF (No. 26): McCoy grounded into a double play in his first at-bat. The Home Run Derby contestant also ambushed a first-pitch cutter in the ninth for a single.

Justin DeCriscio, SS: Final 2 Vote winner Justin DeCriscio pulled off a squeeze bunt to give his team the lead they would not relinquish in the eighth. The RBI single came off his bat at 15.1 mph. He also flew out to right in the ninth.

RockiesJared Thomas, OF (No. 10): In the midst of his second Fall League campaign after only 32 regular-season games, the 2024 second-rounder earned a Fall Stars nod. The 23-year-old lefty connected on two deep flyouts with exit velocities greater than 94 mph.

Jack O’Dowd, C: One of the best hitters in the Fall League this season with a .995 OPS, O'Dowd struck out on a curveball in the dirt by Patrick Reilly in his lone at-bat. The 2026 nondrafted free agent reached first base on the wild pitch, though, and later shared some touching moments on the MLB Network broadcast with his father, former Rockies GM Dan O'Dowd.

Andy Perez, SS (No. 15): Perez packed a punch behind his lone hit after coming off the bench in the sixth. The 22-year-old lefty hitter connected a single at 103.6 mph and flew out in his second opportunity.

Fidel Ulloa, RHP: Ulloa fanned Top 100 prospect Arjun Nimmala on seven pitches in the ninth. The 23-year-old then came out of the game after giving up a softly hit double to Luke Hill and the bequeathed runner eventually scored.
items.titleZh: 秋季明星赛潜力新秀表现盘点
items.summaryZh: 亚利桑那秋季联盟秋季明星赛落幕，国家联盟以 7 比 4 击败美国联盟，红人队的 Yerlin Confidan 荣膺 MVP，多位百大潜力新秀登场亮相。
bodyZh: 亚利桑那州斯科茨代尔报道——第 20 届年度秋季明星赛落下帷幕，这是一场竞争激烈的对决，充分展现了美国联盟和国家联盟阵容中出色的天赋。
国家联盟在第八局突然爆发，彻底扭转了局势，最终在会谈之棒盐河球场以 7 比 4 取得胜利。这是国联自 2022 年以来的首场胜利。
红人队外场手 Yerlin Confidan 荣膺本场比赛的 MVP，加入此前曾获此殊荣的知名球员行列，包括 Colson Montgomery（2023年）、JJ Bleday（2021年）、Royce Lewis（2019年）以及 Gary Sánchez（2015年）。
MLB Pipeline 百大潜力新秀榜单中有 10 名成员登场亮相，许多人展现出他们为何很快能成为各自大联盟球队不可或缺的重要拼图。
总计有 60 名球员在这场比赛中登场——以下是他们的表现盘点。
跳转至：美联东区 | 美联中区 | 美联西区 | 国联东区 | 国联中区 | 国联西区
美国联盟东区
蓝鸟队 Jake Bloss，右投手（第 11 名）：Bloss 在投球三分之二局中的表现不太理想——被敲出两支安打失两分并送出一次保送——但他的球质依然出色。他的直球最快达到 98.2 英里/小时，在 11 次挥击中让对手挥空 5 次。
蓝鸟队 Jake Cook，外场手（第 20 名）：可以说是秋季联盟中跑垒速度最快的球员，Cook 在第六局作为代跑合理登场，随后接管右外野守备直到比赛结束。在他唯一一次打击机会中，他站着被三振出局。
蓝鸟队 Aaron Parker，捕手：在奉献了一场精彩的本垒打大赛表演不到 24 小时后，Parker 作为指定打击先发登场。这位身高 5 英尺 7 寸的捕手（他在秋季联盟大部分时间担任左外野手）吞下两次三振并获得一次保送，凭借出色的选球选到保送并带有一分打点。
金莺队 Ike Irish，外场手/一垒手（第 5 名/MLB 第 95 名）：对 Irish 来说这是一个忙碌的夜晚，他在三个打席中选到保送、敲出一支内野安打并因失误上垒。他先发镇守右外野，并送出一记时速 94.5 英里的传球将跑者定在垒上，这一数据如果在今年大联盟中将排在臂力表现的第 99 百分位。
金莺队 Patrick Reilly，右投手：这位右投手为美联先发登场并遭遇控球难题，在前三位面对的打者身上连续投出保送，随后及时调整送出两次三振，将失分控制在仅丢一分。他的四缝线直球平均时速为 96.2 英里，并具备接近顶尖的 19 英寸垂直位移。
金莺队 Braxton Bragg，右投手（第 22 名）：这位 2023 年第八轮新秀度过了极具统治力的一局（仅用 10 球），他连续三振了前两位面对的打者——一个让对手看着卡特球被三振，另一个则是让对手挥空伸卡球——随后制造了一个简单的滚地球结束了他的夜晚。
金莺队 Vance Honeycutt，外场手：作为联盟中各项工具最全面的球员之一，他凭借秋季出色的表现赢得了中外野先发的机会。这位球队 2024 年选秀首轮秀在三个打席中吞下两次三振并获得一次保送。
光芒队 Nathan Flewelling，捕手（第 4 名/MLB 第 63 名）：作为本场比赛本垒板后面的先发捕手，这位全明星未来之星赛 MVP 此役 3 打数 0 安打，但在第三局曾击出一记时速 101 英里的强劲平飞球被左外野手没收。他在第一局成功阻杀了一次盗垒尝试，随后在第四局再次阻止盗垒时送出时速 83.9 英里的传球（相当于今年大联盟的第 95 百分位）。
光芒队 Marcus Johnson，右投手：这位身高 6 英尺 6 寸的右投手利用他的五种球路组合投出无失分的第五局，其中包括三振了百大潜力新秀 Tate Southisene。他积极攻击好球带，23 球中有 17 球是好球，虽然被敲出两支安打，但通过让最后两名打者击出高飞球化解危机。
红袜队 Antonio Anderson，一垒手/三垒手：这位左右开弓的内野边线球员在周六的本垒打大赛中展现了出色的长打实力，随后在第一局面对百大潜力新秀 Jarlin Susana 时敲出一支反方向安打。他在随后的两个打席中切换回右打位，均吞下三振。
洋基队 Dax Kilby，游击手（第 1 名/MLB 第 78 名）：由于美联内野人才济济，Kilby 作为后段棒次的指定打击替补登场。这位球队 2025 年首轮秀面对两名右投手时均挥空吞下三振。
洋基队 Chris Veach，右投手：这位未选秀自由球员的登场时间非常短暂，他仅投了 3 球就让面对的唯一一名打者通过高飞球出局。他投了两颗球速在 70 英里/小时中段的变速球，平均拥有惊人的 48 英寸下坠幅度。
洋基队 Kyle West，一垒手：在周末到来前以 6 支本垒打并列秋季联盟本垒打王，West 以一垒手身份替补登场，在两个打席中均挥空吞下三振。
美国联盟中区
守护者队 Luke Hill，二垒手（第 15 名）：Hill 作为防守替补登场，并抓住了进攻机会。他在第七局选到保送，并在第九局击出一支二垒安打，随后跑回美联本场比赛的最后一分。不过他在第九局因传球失误让国联得到一分。
守护者队 Welbyn Francisca，游击手（第 19 名）：秋季联盟的 OPS（进攻指数）领跑者（1.198）此役 3 打数 1 安打，包含一支单安打、一次盗垒并得到一分。他在二游防区均有登场，奉献了两次精彩的防守表现，但也因在二垒发生了一次代价高昂的传球失误，让国联在第五局攻下两分。
皇家队 Angeibel Gomez，外场手（第 2 名/MLB 第 76 名）：Gomez 替补上场顶替同队的皇家组织队友 Zion Rose 镇守左外野。他在两个打席中皆吞下三振，不过他在秋季联盟目前的打击率为 .293。
皇家队 Zion Rose，外场手（第 6 名）：Rose 作为美联开路先锋并镇守左外野。他在打击时选到一次保送并吞下两次三振。他在第三局选到保送后遭到牵制出局。
皇家队 Justin Lamkin，左投手（第 8 名）：Lamkin 干净利落地投出了一局三上三下。他投出的 7 球中有 6 球是好球，最快直球速度达到 94.4 英里/小时。
老虎队 无活跃参赛球员
双城队 Kyle DeBarge，三栖球员：DeBarge 此役三次上垒，包括一支二垒安打（击球初速 104.4 英里/小时）、一支单安打以及一次保送。他还盗了两个垒包，并在第五局通过迫使对手传球失误并趁机跑回本垒得到一分。
白袜队 Jonathan Clark，右投手：Clark 在第八局登场，并利用变速球三振了一名打者结束该局。他在第九局下半续投，被 Alex McCoy 敲出安打后被 Kenya Huggins 换下。
美国联盟西区
天使队 Arjun Nimmala，游击手（第 1 名/MLB 第 34 名）：在交易截止日前被多伦多蓝鸟队交易后，Nimmala披上了天使队的战袍，此役替补登场镇守游击。这位 2023 年首轮秀经历了两个 5 球的打席，但均被三振出局。
太空人队 Jank Pichardo，右投手：在最近一场秋季联盟先发表现欠佳后，Pichardo 此役投出了一局无失分的后援。这位 22 岁投手面对 Andy Perez 被敲出一支时速 103.6 英里的安打，随后让 Alex McCoy 打出双杀打化解该局。
运动家队 Davis Diaz，捕手/内野手（第 19 名）：作为第六局的替补球员，Diaz 击出一支时速 99.8 英里的平飞安打，但在唯一一次打击机会中尝试盗二垒遭到触杀出局。
运动家队 Kenya Huggins，右投手（第 23 名）：作为美联最后一位登场的投手，Huggins 上场时比赛胜负已定。这位 23 岁投手被敲出一支轻巧的带有一分打点的安打，随后通过一次外野飞球和一次内野高飞球结束了比赛。
水手队 Adam Smith，右投手：Smith 丢掉三分（含四支安打与一次保送）吞下败投。这位 26 岁投手通过双杀制造了两个出局数，在投了 21 球（其中 10 个好球）后被换下场。
游击手 Sebastian Walcott，游击手（第 1 名/MLB 第 8 名）：在经历缩水常规赛并在双 A 和三 A 磨练后，Walcott 这个秋天一直保持着火热状态。在秋季明星赛中分担游击和三垒守备时，这位 20 岁小将击出了一记飞行距离 386 英尺、击球初速 94.5 英里的外野飞球（最终被接杀）。他还有一次滚地球出局。
游击手 Paxton Kling，外场手（第 20 名）：自从在第六局替补登场后，Kling 在打击时打出了几次扎实的球。他在第七局击出平飞球出局，随后在第九局敲出一支带有一分打点的安打。
游击手 Julian Brock，捕手：Brock 在其唯一一次打击机会中选到保送，经过一场 6 球的缠斗后上垒，最终留在了三垒。
游击手 Alejandro Chiquillo，右投手：在前 8 球制造两个出局数后，Chiquillo 被 Yerlin Confidan 抓到一颗低角度变速球，击出一支飞行距离 371 英尺的二垒安打。在面对得点圈有人的危机时，这位 23 岁投手让 Dillon Lewis 击出强劲平飞球出局，化解危机安然下场。
订阅 MLB Pipeline 通讯
国家联盟东区
勇士队 Tate Southisene，游击手/二垒手（第 3 名/MLB 第 58 名）：这位 20 岁的天才球员在第一局选到保送并跑回本垒得分，随后在随后的两个打席中吞下三振。作为国联先发游击手，他在防守端也记下了两次出局数。
勇士队 Briggs McKenzie，左投手（第 8 名）：拥有秋季联盟中最具爆发力的球质之一，McKenzie 在登场时难以掌控球路，被敲出三支安打送出三次保送失两分。他在 5 次滑球中让对手挥空 2 次，转速最高达到 3,033 转/分。
马林鱼队 Dillon Lewis，外场手（第 11 名）：记分牌上显示这位右打者 2 打数 0 安打，但这两次出局都击球相当强劲——第六局击向左外野的时速 99.9 英里平飞球出局，以及第八局击出的时速 96.5 英里滚地球（形成双杀打）。他还镇守中外野追到了当晚飞得最远的球，那是 Sebastian Walcott 击出的 386 英尺外野飞球。
大都会队 Irving Cota，右投手：在第六局因一次失误和野手选择陷入困境后，Cota 连续对阵三名百大潜力新秀，送出一个高飞球和两次三振，化解危机全身而退。作为今年秋季联盟表现最好的后援投手之一，他主要倚赖伸卡球与滑球的搭配，随后用四缝线直球和曲球拿下三振。
大都会队 Ryan Lambert，右投手：作为本场比赛球速第三快的投手，Lambert 的球速最快达到 98.3 英里/小时，同时三振一名打者并投出一次保送。他投出 9 记火球，平均时速达 97 英里。
国民队 Jarlin Susana，右投手（第 4 名/MLB 第 66 名）：小联盟中最顶尖的火球男之一展现了惊人的球速，在一局无失分的投球中五次球速超过 102 英里/小时。这位 22 岁投手送出两次三振——均是面对他 80 英里/小时中段的横扫滑球（Sweeper）让对手看着被三振。
国民队 Teo Banks，外场手：在秋季联盟的爆发表现为 Banks 赢得了国联先发右外野手的位置。这位 2024 年第 18 轮新秀在第二局击出内野高飞球出局，第四局遭到触身球上垒。
国民队 Kevin Bazzell，捕手：虽然直到第七局才登场，但这位 2024 年第三轮新秀一上场就产生了巨大影响。Bazzell 在第八局成功阻杀试图盗垒的跑者以守住平局，随后在半局下半击出一支时速 100.3 英里的二垒安打并跑回超前分。他在第九局选到保送为当晚画下句点。
费城人队 Aidan Miller，三垒手/游击手（第 2 名/MLB 第 59 名）：作为国联仅有的两名单场敲出多安打的打者之一（另一位是组织队友 Luke Davis），Miller 面对一记 98.2 英里的直球敲出安打并在第四局跑回本垒得分，随后在下一局又敲出一支内野安打。
费城人队 Luke Davis，捕手：在秋季联盟上垒率排名第二（.537，仅次于 Miller），Davis 也享受了一个单场双安的夜晚——第八局敲出一支时速 100.3 英里的安打，第九局再添一支内野安打。
国家联盟中区
酿酒人队 Eric Bitonti，一垒手/三垒手（第 26 名）：Bitonti 在第四局经历了一次事件丰富的跑垒。他通过挑战自动好球好球带系统（ABS）选到保送上垒。随后靠着暴投推进，并在 Carlos Sanchez 的安打护送下跑回本垒得分。Bitonti 作为国联先发一垒手守了五局。
酿酒人队 Matthew Wood，捕手：Wood 在第四局接替捕手工作，并在本垒板后方镇守了三局。他在两个打席中均击出外野飞球出局。
红雀队 Tai Peete，外场手（第 17 名）：刚刚在周六闯入本垒打大赛决赛，Peete 本场比赛 2 打数 0 安打。不过他在第一局经历了一次 9 球的缠斗选到保送，并展现了他 60 级的速度完成一次盗垒。他随后还尝试盗三垒，但被 Nathan Flewelling 传球阻杀结束该局。
小熊队 Kade Snell，外场手：Snell 作为左外野防守替补登场，全场 3 打数 1 安打。他在三垒方向击出内野高飞球结束了秋季明星赛。
海盗队 Wyatt Sanford，游击手/二垒手（第 5 名）：Sanford 作为游击防守替补登场。这位海盗队潜力新秀 2 打数 0 安打并吞下一次三振。
海盗队 Bryan Mena，右投手：Mena 在第九局一人出局时登场，因 Paxton Kling 的安打失掉了一分自责分（继承跑者得分）。Mena 随后利用他的变速球系球路送出两次三振。
红人队 Carlos Sanchez，三垒手/游击手/外场手（第 14 名）：Sanchez 在第四局敲出一支带有一分打点的安打并成功盗上二垒。这位 21 岁三垒手还在第二局击出一记时速 101.5 英里的平飞球出局，展现了长打潜力。
红人队 Yerlin Confidan，外场手：在秋季联盟征战期间已崭露头角的 Confidan 荣膺 MVP，他在第六局面对一颗击球初速 97.9 英里、飞越 371 英尺的中外野二垒安打表现惊艳，并在第八局满垒时选到保送带有一分打点。
红人队 Luke Holman，右投手：Holman 在他负责的一局投球中送出两次三振。他的直球球速高达 94 英里/小时，在 23 球中制造了 6 次挥空。Holman 三振了秋季联盟本垒打大赛冠军 Aaron Parker 以及 2026 年全明星未来之星赛 MVP Nathan Flewelling。
国家联盟西区
响尾蛇队 Demetrio Crisantes，二垒手（第 1 名/MLB 第 84 名）：在过去这个赛季因肩伤恢复而上场时间受限后，Crisantes 在秋季联盟中充分展现了他的各项球技，他在第五局击出了一记时速 103.5 英里的单安打。这位 22 岁球员还选到保送并击出滚地球出局。
响尾蛇队 Joe Ariola，左投手：Ariola 的任务是在第八局一人在垒时抓下两个出局数。这位 22 岁投手被敲出一记穿透中路的强劲安打，随后 Bazzell 阻杀跑者。这位左投随后仅用三球就三振了 Angeibel Gomez——其中包括一记落在地上的 81.3 英里/小时曲球——将跑者留在了三垒。
道奇队 Brooks Auger，右投手（第 28 名）：在第七局开局与 Hill 经过 6 球缠斗送出保送后，这位 25 岁投手连续三振两名打者并制造 5 次挥空，随后干净利落地解决了接下来三名打者。
道奇队 Luke Fox，左投手：Fox 在第五局面对本场比赛面对的第三球被 Kyle DeBarge 敲出二垒安打。DeBarge 随后盗上三垒，并利用 Fox 的传球失误跑回本垒得分。这位洛杉矶的左投手随后稳住阵脚，用 14 球连续三振三名打者。
巨人队 Dalton Wentz，三垒手：Wentz 是国家联盟唯一一位没有在比赛中登场的野手。
教士队 Kannon Kemp，右投手（第 13 名）：Kemp 在满垒且两人出局时登场，被 Nathan Flewelling 击出一记深远且强劲的外野飞球（被接杀）。这位 22 岁投手在第四局投出三上三下，在一场 7 球的对决中用滑球三振了 Zion Rose。这位 2023 年第八轮新秀球速达到 99.3 英里/小时，并在 8 次挥击中制造 3 次挥空。
教士队 Alex McCoy，外场手（第 26 名）：McCoy 在他的第一个打席中击出双杀打。这位本垒打大赛参赛者还在第九局抓准第一球的卡特球敲出一支安打。
教士队 Justin DeCriscio，游击手：倒数第 2 轮投票优胜者 Justin DeCriscio 成功执行短打（Squeeze bunt），为球队在第八局取得此后保持到终场的领先优势。这支带有一分打点的安打击球初速为 15.1 英里/小时。他还在第九局击出右外野飞球出局。
洛矶队 Jared Thomas，外场手（第 10 名）：在仅打了 32 场常规赛后迎来第二个秋季联盟征战赛季，这位 2024 年第二轮新秀赢得了秋季明星赛的青睐。这位 23 岁左打者击出了两记击球初速超过 94 英里/小时的深远外野飞球。
洛矶队 Jack O’Dowd，捕手：作为本赛季秋季联盟打击率最高、OPS 达 .995 的打者之一，O'Dowd 在其唯一一次打击机会中被 Patrick Reilly 投出的落地曲球三振。不过这位 2026 年未选秀自由球员因暴投跑上一垒，随后在 MLB Network 的转播中与他的父亲、前洛矶队总经理 Dan O'Dowd 共同分享了一些感人的时刻。
洛矶队 Andy Perez，游击手（第 15 名）：Perez 在第六局替补登场后，其唯一的安打极具爆发力。这位 22 岁左打者击出一支击球初速达 103.6 英里的安打，并在第二次打击机会中击出飞球出局。
洛矶队 Fidel Ulloa，右投手：Ulloa 在第九局用 7 球三振了百大潜力新秀 Arjun Nimmala。这位 23 岁投手随后在被 Luke Hill 敲出一支轻巧的二垒安打后退场，留下的垒上跑者最终得分。
