items.titleEn: Breaking down the Fall Stars Game participants by organization
bodyEn: The Arizona Fall League created a Fall Stars Game in 2006 to highlight the most talented players in a circuit full of top prospects. The first 19 contests spotlighted several future big league notables such as Ronald Acuña Jr., Pete Alonso, Mookie Betts, Bryce Harper, Aaron Judge, Francisco Lindor, Andrew McCutchen, Buster Posey, Julio Rodríguez, Max Scherzer, Corey Seager and Mike Trout.

The 2025 Fall Stars Game included 2026 American League Rookie of the Year favorite Kevin McGonigle and three White Sox who keyed a shocking playoff run this season (Sam Antonacci, Braden Montgomery, Hagen Smith). This year's rosters are as loaded as always.

The prospect showcase will be played at Scottsdale's Salt River Fields on Sunday at 8 p.m. ET/6 p.m. local. The game will be broadcast on MLB Network and streamed on MLB.com and the MLB app, with Paul Severino handling play-by-play duties and former Rockies general manager Dan O'Dowd and MLB Pipeline's Jim Callis providing analysis.

Of the 13 Top 100 prospects still on AFL rosters, 10 will participate in the Fall Stars Game: right-hander Jarlin Susana (Nationals); catcher Nathan Flewellling (Rays); second baseman Demetrio Crisantes (Diamondbacks); third baseman Aidan Miller (Phillies); shortstops Dax Kilby (Yankees), Arjun Nimmala (Angels), Tate Southisene (Braves) and Sebastian Walcott (Rangers); and outfielders Angeibel Gomez (Royals) and Ike Irish (Orioles). Two other Top 100 prospects, Dodgers second baseman Charles Davalan and outfielder Eduardo Quintero, could be added via the Final 2 Vote.
Below are reports on all the Fall Stars:
Jump to: AL East | AL Central | AL West | NL East | NL Central | NL West
AMERICAN LEAGUE EAST

Blue JaysJake Bloss, RHP (No. 11): The rare Fall Leaguer with Major League experience, Bloss has dealt with multiple injuries in the Blue Jays' system since his time in The Show with the Astros, most notably last year’s right elbow surgery and this year’s right teres major strain. In the AFL to make up for lost time, he has sat 93-96 mph with a pair of fastballs and shown a full complement of secondaries including a sweeper, slider, curveball and changeup, though results have been mixed (10 ER, 11 K's, 2 BB in 10 2/3 innings).

Jake Cook, OF (No. 20): The 2025 third-rounder out of Southern Miss is known primarily for his speed, as he’s shown throughout the fall with several Sprint Speeds above 30 ft/sec and 10 steals in 12 attempts over 14 games for Mesa. After missing time early in his first full season due to a hamstring injury, he has a .328/.381/.362 line with a pair of doubles in AFL play.

Aaron Parker, C: The UC Santa Barbara product broke out in the power department with 19 homers over 87 games for Double-A New Hampshire in his second full season over the summer, and he has continued producing this autumn with a .351 average and a .479 on-base percentage over 48 plate appearances while mixing in work in left field.

OriolesIke Irish, OF/1B (No. 5/MLB No. 95): The Orioles’ first-round pick out of Auburn in the 2025 Draft, Irish was having a fine first full season, and was poised for a promotion to Double-A, when he tore his left meniscus shortly after appearing in the Futures Game. The AFL is his first action since then, and he’s shown no rust, slashing .327/.456/.491 in 15 games.

Patrick Reilly, RHP: Acquired from the Pirates in 2024 for Billy Cook, Reilly ranked as high as No. 10 on the Orioles’ Top 30 in the past. He had Tommy John surgery after three starts in 2025, making it back to throw 53 innings in 2026. The pure stuff is very much still there, with a fastball up to 98 mph and a slider that has elicited a 43-percent miss rate this fall.

RaysNathan Flewelling, C (No. 4/MLB No. 63): The pride of Red Deer, Alberta, grew in prospect stature by clubbing 21 homers and finishing with a 112 wRC+ over 106 games at High-A Bowling Green in his age-19 season in 2026, but he hasn’t stopped there with more work with Scottsdale this fall. He’s gone 20-for-72 (.278) with two doubles in 19 games (14 of which have been behind the plate) for the Solar Sox.

Marcus Johnson, RHP: The 25-year-old has very much been control-over-stuff as a pro with a career 4.4 percent walk rate in the Minors between the Marlins' and Rays' systems. He’s worked primarily with a 90-92 mph sinker and 87-89 mph cutter in the Fall League (where he has a 7.45 ERA and 19 strikeouts in 19 ⅓ innings) while also folding in a slider, four-seamer and curveball.

Red SoxAntonio Anderson, 1B/3B: Signed for a well over-slot $1.5 million as a 2023 third-rounder from a Georgia high school, Anderson is a switch-hitter who's more dangerous from the right side of the plate. He ranks third in the AFL in OPS (1.123) while slashing .361/.500/.623 with three homers and 17 walks in 16 games.

YankeesDax Kilby, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 78): A 2025 supplemental first-rounder, Kilby is one of the best pure hitters in the Fall League, makes advanced swing decisions and possesses plus raw power and speed. After missing much of the Minor League season with a hamstring injury, the Georgia prep product is batting .295/.357/.623 with 12 extra-base hits and five steals in 15 games.
AMERICAN LEAGUE CENTRAL

GuardiansLuke Hill, 2B (No. 15): Hill established himself as one of the most disciplined hitters in the Southeastern Conference while at Mississippi, which got him drafted in the fourth round in 2025. He showed increased power in his first full pro season and is hitting .333/.420/.548 with two homers in 11 games.

Welbyn Francisca, SS (No. 19): The biggest breakout player in the AFL, Francisca is slashing .409/.467/.667 with three homers and five steals in 14 games, and he leads the league in batting, hits (27) and RBI (24). Signed for $1,375,000 out of the Dominican Republic in 2023, he has the hitting ability, pop and speed to become a 20-20 player and potentially could stick at shortstop.

RoyalsAngeibel Gomez, OF (No. 2/MLB No. 76): As the second-youngest player ever to appear in the AFL, the 17-year-old outfielder has held his own nicely in the jump from the Dominican Summer League with a .306/.390/.444 line over 10 games for Surprise. Gomez has true five-tool potential and has seen time at all three outfield spots this fall, though the bulk of his time has come in right.

Zion Rose, OF (No. 6): Rose may have been a surprise in the industry as the sixth overall pick this year, but he’s fit right in offensively among the AFL’s top prospects this fall with a .327/.493/.519 line, two homers, two triples, 14 walks and 12 steals in 13 games for Surprise. The outfielder is in the AFL in the first place to help make for lost at-bats from the spring when he dealt with ankle and hamstring injuries at Louisville.

Justin Lamkin, LHP (No. 8): The 2025 71st overall pick out of Texas A&M looked well on his way to a breakout this season with a 2.04 ERA and 53 strikeouts in 39 2/3 innings at High-A and Double-A before a left shoulder injury ended his regular season in late May. Back and healthy, he’s still building up velocity in the AFL but has been exceptional at getting ahead of hitters early with his fastball while showing two good breakers in his curveball (a relatively new pitch) and slider, leading to a 3.52 ERA and a 0.78 WHIP in four starts (15 1/3 innings).
TigersNo active participants

TwinsKyle DeBarge, UTIL: The Twins’ pick at No. 33 overall in the 2024 Draft, DeBarge was certainly hoping to forget about the worries on his mind after a rough 2026 season in Double-A (.221/.335/.352). He’s been having a good time the whole AFL long, sitting fifth in the league with his 1.094 OPS.

White SoxJonathan Clark, RHP: A San Jose State product signed after two seasons in the independent Pioneer League, Clark relies heavily on a mid-80s slider while mixing in a lively 92-96 mph fastball. He's sporting a 3.68 ERA, a .111 opponents' average and an 11/1 K/BB ratio in 7 1/3 innings.
AMERICAN LEAGUE WEST

AngelsArjun Nimmala, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 34): Right hamstring issues limited Nimmala to a total of 89 games in 2026, but after getting traded to the Angels from the Blue Jays for José Soriano, he was one of the hottest hitters in the Minors, with seven homers and an .826 SLG in 11 September games before hitting three more long balls in the playoffs. He’s been a little streaky this fall, but has put together a .301/.446/.507 line over 18 games.

AstrosJank Pichardo, RHP: Coming back from 2025 Tommy John surgery, Pichardo sports an 8.74 ERA but has struck out 17 in 11 1/3 innings, good for the fourth-best K rate (13.5 per nine innings) in the league. He signed for $10,000 out of the Dominican Republic in 2022 and delivers his 92-97 mph fastball on an extremely flat approach angle.

A’sDavis Diaz, C/INF (No. 19): The A’s eighth-rounder in 2024 is coming off his best professional season, reaching Triple-A and finishing with double-digit home runs and steals while posting a combined .804 OPS, all while continuing to learn the nuances of catching while moving around the field. He’s been focusing on his work as a backstop this fall while continuing to swing the bat well, with a .302/.436/.442 line through 12 games.

Kenya Huggins, RHP (No. 23): Acquired from the Reds at the 2025 Trade Deadline, Huggins is shaking off a very uneven first full season in the A’s organization (6.63 ERA) pitching out of Mesa’s bullpen. He’s had a largely effective Fall League, with a 2.16 ERA and an 11.9 K/9 rate over five appearances thanks to a fastball he’s run up to 99 mph and a cutter-like slider that touches 90-91 mph.

MarinersAdam Smith, RHP: It’s been a journey for Smith, who began his pro career as a 14th-round pick of the Padres in 2021. Released by San Diego after the 2023 season, he signed as a free agent with the Red Sox, but became a Minor League free agent again after two seasons. The sinker-slider reliever began this year in indy ball, but signed with the Mariners in May, pitching his way from High-A to Double-A at age 26.

RangersSebastian Walcott, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 8): The highest-rated prospect in the Fall League, Walcott stands out with his well-above-average raw power and arm strength. After missing much of the Minor League season recovering from internal brace surgery in February, he's back to playing shortstop and may see some outfield action as well. Signed for $3.2 million out of the Bahamas in 2023, he's hitting .316/.369/.474 with nine steals in 13 games.

Paxton Kling, OF (No. 20): A center fielder with 25-25 upside, Kling has some of the best all-around tools in the Rangers' system, but inconsistency at the plate dropped him to the seventh round of the 2025 Draft after he played at Louisiana State and Penn State. He's batting .364/.478/.455 with 13 steals in 14 games.

Julian Brock, C: Brock offers plus raw power but doesn't make consistent contact, and he provides decent defense with a strong arm behind the plate. The 2023 eighth-rounder from Louisiana-Lafayette is hitting .211/.426/.263 with 14 walks in 13 games.

Alejandro Chiquillo, RHP: Signed for $5,000 out of Colombia in 2024, Chiquillo owns a 94-96 mph fastball that reaches 98 and a mid-80s slider. He has compiled a 5.52 ERA with 16 strikeouts in 14 2/3 innings.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
NATIONAL LEAGUE EAST

BravesTate Southisene, SS/2B (No. 3/MLB No. 58): The Braves’ first-rounder in 2025, Southisene exceeded expectations by playing his way from Single-A up to Double-A in his first full season, posting an .875 OPS through 90 games. A hit-by-pitch caused a fractured wrist in his first Double-A game, but the infielder has picked up where left off in the AFL, with a .341/.482/.432 line over 13 games.

Briggs McKenzie, LHP (No. 8): The Braves went well over slot to sign McKenzie out of the North Carolina high school ranks in 2025, giving him nearly $3 million in the fourth round. He got off to a hot start in 2026, zooming to High-A Rome, but nerve irritation in his left forearm kept him on the sidelines for all but 26 innings this year. He’s had two terrible outings this fall (13 earned runs, 5 1/3 IP), but has given up just two earned over his other 15 1/3 innings of work, including spinning four shutout frames on Tuesday.

MarlinsDillon Lewis, OF (No. 11): Part of the Ryan Weathers trade with the Yankees last January, Lewis is seeking to become the first big leaguer from Queens College. He combines plus raw power and speed and he's batting .283/.333/.433 in 15 games.

MetsIrving Cota, RHP: Cota went from a $10,000 signing as a 19-year-old out of Mexico in 2023 to the Double-A level two years later. He works with an east-west arsenal out of a low-three quarters release, highlighted by a 92-95 mph sinker and 84-86 mph changeup that both get significant armside run. He has good control despite the movement and has struck out 15 and walked only three over 12 2/3 relief innings this fall.

Ryan Lambert, RHP: Lambert looked like he could have ridden his upper-90s cut-ride fastball to a chance in New York’s MLB bullpen this summer, though control issues and a right forearm flexor injury slowed him down. He’s looked back on track for Surprise with 10 strikeouts and four walks over six scoreless, hitless innings while adding in a longer slider to complement the heat and his shorter breaking ball.

Teo Banks, OF: After hitting .251 with six homers and a 90 wRC+ in 92 games for High-A Wilmington during the regular season, Banks has made the most of the AFL spotlight with a .366/.413/.620 line and nine extra-base hits in 21 games for Salt River while rotating across all three outfield positions.

Kevin Bazzell, C: Bazzell enters Wednesday as the AFL OPS leader with a 1.169 mark through 14 games. He’s gone 14-for-37 (.378) with two homers, four doubles, seven walks and only four strikeouts in that span. That’s a solid turn for a catcher who missed almost a month of action between April and May after being hit in the face by a pitch.

NationalsJarlin Susana, RHP (No. 4/MLB No. 66): Susana will certainly bring the heat if he appears Sunday; he’s responsible for the 65 fastest pitches of the Fall League this year, topping out at 103.8 mph. His mid-80s curveball gives him another plus-plus weapon beyond his four-seamer and sinker, and he’s worked on adding a sweeper and cutter this fall. After missing time rehabbing from last year’s lat surgery, the 6-foot-6 righty leads the Fall League with 26 strikeouts in 18 2/3 innings.

PhilliesAidan Miller, 3B/SS (No. 2/MLB No. 59): After missing nearly all of the 2026 season with back issues, the biggest thing people wanted to see was Miller healthy. After making it back to help Reading win the Double-A Eastern League title, Miller has looked terrific this fall, hitting .333/.562/.500 with six steals, and he is looking comfortable in his first extended time at third base.
NATIONAL LEAGUE CENTRAL

BrewersEric Bitonti, 1B/3B (No. 26): Standing 6-foot-5, the 20-year-old corner infielder is built like a house and has the power potential to match as he proved with 25 homers between High-A and Double-A in his second full season. The left-handed-hitting masher has added two more while hitting .275/.383/.451 in 15 games for Scottsdale this autumn, though he’s also struck out 31.7 percent of the time in the continuation of another theme of his young career.

Matthew Wood, C: Wood showed off good discipline and improved angles off the bat, leading to a .398 OBP, career-best 18 homers and a 52/71 K/BB ratio in 95 games for Double-A Biloxi during the regular season. Facing Rule 5 eligibility this offseason, he’s certainly carried those good swing decisions to Scottsdale with a .489 OBP and 6/13 K/BB over 12 games in the Fall League while splitting time between catching and DH duties.

CardinalsTai Peete, OF (No. 17): After missing time due to illness this summer, Peete has been one of the most electric and energetic players of the entire AFL this fall and ranks among the circuit’s top three with 11 extra-base hits, 41 total bases and 13 steals through 16 games. He’s hit .328/.410/.612 in that time while displaying the power-speed combo that could make him at least a 25-25 threat in the bigs if he can make enough contact.

CubsKade Snell, OF: One of the top college senior prospects in the 2025 Draft because of his combination of offensive production, data and makeup, Snell went in the fifth round out of Alabama. He's slashing .286/.438/.381 with nine steals in 17 games.

PiratesWyatt Sanford, SS/2B (No. 5): The Pirates’ second-rounder in 2024, Sanford took a huge leap forward in his second full season of pro ball, especially in terms of impact, homering 19 times to go along with 33 steals over 77 games. He missed nearly two months with a hand injury, costing him a promotion to Double-A. There are still some swing-and-miss issues to keep cleaning up, but he does have four extra-base hits in 15 games for an .803 OPS this fall.

RedsLuke Holman, RHP: The Reds were excited to select Holman in the second round of the 2024 Draft out of LSU, but this is really the first long look they’ve gotten to see of him in competitive action. Elbow issues that led to Tommy John surgery have limited him to just 15 2/3 total innings over his first two years of pro ball, but he’s been one of the best arms in the AFL, topping the circuit with his .114 BAA and using his four-pitch mix to sit second in ERA (0.69) and third with his 13.9 K/9 rate over 13 IP.

Yerlin Confidan, OF: There’s work to be done on his approach (15/3 K/BB in 13 AFL games), but the toolsy Confidan has been one of the nicest surprises this fall. He’s registered some of the best exit velocities in the league and he’s tied for fourth with 10 extra-base hits that have resulted in an OPS of 1.053, good for eighth best.
NATIONAL LEAGUE WEST

D-backsDemetrio Crisantes, 2B (No. 1/MLB No. 84): A career .312 hitter in the Minor Leagues, the Arizona native has dealt with injuries throughout his career, most recently a hamstring issue coming out of this year’s Spring Training. He still has the plus hit tool to push for a spot on the D-backs infield by 2027, and he’s flashed some speed with seven steals in seven attempts for Salt River this fall.

Joe Ariola, LHP: The 2025 seventh-rounder out of Wake Forest was one of the Minors’ most effective left-handed relievers in his first full season with a 1.56 ERA, 1.04 WHIP and 64 strikeouts in 34 2/3 innings across Single-A, High-A and Double-A. The results have continued in the Fall League (two earned runs, nine strikeouts in 6 1/3 innings), thanks to playing the north-south game with a 93-95 mph four-seamer with good ride and a 78-81 mph curveball.

DodgersChase Harlan, 3B (No. 9): One of the top third-base prospects in baseball, Harlan features double-plus raw power and the strong arm required for the hot corner. A third-round pick out of a Pennsylvania high school in 2024, he's batting .276/.403/.586 with five homers in 16 games.

Brooks Auger, RHP (No. 28): Primarily a reliever at Mississippi State, where he had Tommy John surgery that sidelined him in 2023 before he became a sixth-round pick the following year, Auger is now a five-pitch starter with an explosive mid-90s fastball and a tight mid-80s slider. He has logged a 7.15 ERA with 13 strikeouts in 11 1/3 innings.

Luke Fox, LHP: Drafted in the 17th round in 2023, when he missed his entire junior season at Duke following Tommy John surgery, Fox commands his 92-96 mph fastball and low-80s slider well. He has compiled a 4.09 ERA with 14 strikeouts in 11 innings.

GiantsDalton Wentz, 3B: One of two 2026 draftees in the AFL, along with Royals first-rounder Zion Rose, Wentz signed for $584,955 (fourth-round money) as a 16th-rounder out of Wake Forest. A switch-hitter with at least plus raw power and solid arm strength, he's slashing .313/.436/.531 in 14 games.

PadresKannon Kemp, RHP (No. 13): Kemp is repeating the Fall League after appearing for Peoria last year, due to a left oblique injury that limited him to 38 2/3 innings over the summer, and he’s shown good velocity with a sinker and a four-seamer both around 96-98 mph. His 88-91 mph changeup, which has similar movement to the sinker but good velo separation, is his best secondary with a 35 percent whiff rate for Peoria.

Alex McCoy, OF (No. 26): McCoy has few rivals when it comes to pure power in this year’s Fall League class as he’s responsible for two of the three exit velocities this fall at 116.3 mph and 118.2 mph on a pair of homers. Ten of the 6-foot-5 masher’s 15 hits for Peoria have gone for extra bases (five homers, five doubles), and while strikeouts are an issue, he owns a .283/.409/.660 line in 66 plate appearances.

RockiesJared Thomas, OF (No. 10): Thomas had hamate surgery after last year’s AFL stint, then needed an additional surgery to remove a bone spur, costing him most of 2026. His swing-and-miss is still an issue (29 K’s over 72 ABs), but he’s shaken off a slow start this fall to record a seven-game hit streak and bring his overall line to an impressive .319/.430/.556.

Jack O’Dowd, C: The son of former GM and current MLB Network analyst Dan O’Dowd (who’ll get to call his son’s action on the Fall Stars Game broadcast), Jack has gone from indy league signing curiosity to legitimate prospect. He hit 23 homers and slugged .564 across three levels in his first year, and he’s shown it was no fluke, leading the AFL in homers (6) and SLG (.687).

Fidel Ulloa, RHP: The Rockies’ seventh-rounder in 2024 out of LSU, the former Draft League participant had a solid year relieving for Double-A Hartford in 2026. He’s been one of the best bullpen arms in the Fall League, having given up no runs over seven appearances, striking out 11.0 per nine with a fastball up to 96 mph and a particularly effective changeup.
items.titleZh: 秋季明星赛各球队参赛球员解析
items.summaryZh: 本文盘点了2025年秋季明星赛的各路潜力新秀与参赛球员表现。
bodyZh: 亚利桑那秋季联赛于2006年创立了秋季明星赛，旨在展现顶级新秀云集的联盟中最具天赋的球员。前19届比赛曾捧红多位未来的大联盟知名球星，例如Ronald Acuña Jr.、Pete Alonso、Mookie Betts、Bryce Harper、Aaron Judge、Francisco Lindor、Andrew McCutchen、Buster Posey、Julio Rodríguez、Max Scherzer、Corey Seager和Mike Trout。
2025年的秋季明星赛包括2026年美国联盟年度最佳新秀热门人选Kevin McGonigle，以及三位在本赛季打出惊奇季后赛之旅的白袜球员（Sam Antonacci、Braden Montgomery、Hagen Smith）。今年的阵容一如既往地星光熠熠。
这场潜力新秀展示赛将于周日美东时间晚上8点/当地时间晚上6点在斯科茨达尔的盐河球场举行。比赛将在MLB Network进行电视直播，并在MLB.com和MLB App上进行流媒体直播，由Paul Severino担任实况转播，前科罗拉多洛矶总经理Dan O'Dowd与MLB Pipeline的Jim Callis担任球评。

在目前仍在秋季联赛阵容中的13名百大潜力新秀中，有10人将参加秋季明星赛：右投手Jarlin Susana（国民）；捕手Nathan Flewellling（光芒）；二垒手Demetrio Crisantes（响尾蛇）；三垒手Aidan Miller（费城人）；游击手Dax Kilby（洋基）、Arjun Nimmala（天使）、Tate Southisene（勇士）和Sebastian Walcott（游击兵）；以及外野手Angeibel Gomez（皇家）和Ike Irish（金莺）。另外两名百大潜力新秀——道奇二垒手Charles Davalan和外野手Eduardo Quintero——可能会通过最终两票（Final 2 Vote）入选。
以下是所有秋季明星的报告：
快速跳转：美联东区 | 美联中区 | 美联西区 | 国联东区 | 国联中区 | 国联西区
美国联盟东区

多伦多蓝鸟：Jake Bloss, RHP (No. 11)：作为少数拥有大联盟经验的秋季联赛球员，Bloss自效力太空人升上大联盟以来，在蓝鸟体系中饱受伤病困扰，最显著的是去年的右肘手术以及今年的右圆肌拉伤。他来到秋季联赛是为了补回失去的时间，其四缝线与双缝线速球球速维持在93-96英里，并展现出完整的变化球种，包括横扫滑球、滑球、曲球和变速球，不过成效参差不齐（在10.2局中失10分自责分，送出11次三振，2次保送）。
Jake Cook, OF (No. 20)：这位南密西西比大学出品的2025年第三轮新秀主要以速度闻名，他在整个秋季展现了数次超过30英尺/秒的冲刺速度，在梅萨队的14场比赛中12次盗垒成功10次。在首个完整赛季初期因腿筋受伤缺阵后，他在秋季联赛缴出.328/.381/.362的打击三围，带有两支二垒安打。
Aaron Parker, C：这位加州圣巴巴拉分校的球员在职业生涯第二个完整赛季的夏天迎来了长打能力的爆发，在双A新罕布什尔效力的87场比赛中轰出19发本垒打。他在今年秋天延续了好手感，在48个打席中交出.351的打击率与.479的上垒率，并兼任左外野守备。
巴尔金莺：Ike Irish, OF/1B (No. 5/MLB No. 95)：作为金莺在2025年选秀中从奥本大学选进的首轮新秀，Irish在首个完整赛季表现出色，本有机会升上双A，却在参加未来之星赛后不久撕裂了左膝半月板。秋季联赛是他伤愈复出的首个实战，他毫无生疏感，在15场比赛中交出.327/.456/.491的攻击三围。
Patrick Reilly, RHP：在2024年交易中为金莺换下Billy Cook，过去在金莺的Top 30榜单中最高曾排名第10。他在2025年仅投3场比赛后接受了托马斯约翰手术，并在2026年重返赛场投了53局。他纯粹的球威依然存在，速球高达98英里，其滑球在今年秋天制造了43%的挥空率。
坦帕湾光芒：Nathan Flewelling, C (No. 4/MLB No. 63)：这位来自艾伯塔省红鹿市的选手在19岁赛季的2026年效力高阶1A鲍灵格林期间，轰出21支本垒打并拿下112的wRC+，提升了自己在潜力新秀中的地位，他在今年秋天在斯科茨达尔继续磨炼。他在为太阳星效力的19场比赛中（其中14场担任捕手）72打数敲出20安（打击率.278），包含2支二垒安打。
Marcus Johnson, RHP：这位25岁投手在职业生涯中展现了极佳的控球胜过球威的特质，在马林鱼和光芒体系的小联盟中生涯保送率仅有4.4%。他在秋季联赛中主要使用90-92英里的伸卡球和87-89英里的卡特球（在秋季联赛中防御率为7.45，在19.1/3局中投出19次三振），同时也融入了滑球、四缝线速球和曲球。
波士顿红袜：Antonio Anderson, 1B/3B：作为2023年从佐治亚州高中通过第三轮选秀以远高于标准身价的150万美元签约的球员，Anderson是一名左右开弓的打者，从右打击区更具威胁。他在秋季联赛的OPS（1.123）排名第三，在16场比赛中缴出.361/.500/.623的打击三围，敲出3支本垒打并获得14次保送。
纽约洋基：Dax Kilby, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 78)：作为2025年补充首轮新秀，Kilby是秋季联赛中纯打击能力最出色的球员之一，具备成熟的挥棒决策能力，并拥有极佳的原始长打火力和速度。在因腿筋伤势缺席了大部分小联盟赛季后，这位佐治亚州高中出品的球员在15场比赛中交出.295/.357/.623的打击三围，有12支长打和5次盗垒。
美国联盟中区
克利夫兰守护者：Luke Hill, 2B (No. 15)：Hill在密西西比大学就读期间确立了自己作为东南联盟最具纪律性打者之一的地位，这让他得以在2025年第四轮被选中。他在职业生涯首个完整赛季展现了增强的长打能力，在11场比赛中交出.333/.420/.548的打击率，带有2支本垒打。
Welbyn Francisca, SS (No. 19)：作为秋季联赛中最大爆发的球员，Francisca在14场比赛中交出.409/.467/.667的攻击三围，敲出3支本垒打和5次盗垒，并在联盟中领跑打击率、安打数（27支）和打点（24分）。他在2023年以1,375,000美元从多米尼加共和国签约，具备成为“20-20”球员的打击能力、爆发力和速度，并且潜在地能够胜任游击手位置。
堪萨斯城皇家：Angeibel Gomez, OF (No. 2/MLB No. 76)：作为秋季联赛历史上第二年轻的参赛球员，这位17岁的外野手在从多米尼加夏季联赛跃升的过程中表现得相当沉稳，在为惊奇队出战的10场比赛中交出.306/.390/.444的成绩单。Gomez拥有真正的五拍子潜力，今年秋天镇守过三个外野位置，其中大部分时间担任右外野手。
Zion Rose, OF (No. 6)：Rose今年作为第六顺位被选中的球员或许让业界感到意外，但他在今年秋天与秋季联赛顶尖新秀的较量中在进攻端表现游刃有余，在为惊奇队出战的13场比赛中交出.327/.493/.519的打击三围，有2支本垒打、2支三垒安打、14次保送和12次盗垒。这位外野手来到秋季联赛主要是为了弥补今年春天在路易斯维尔大学处理脚踝和腿筋伤势时失去的打席。

Justin Lamkin, LHP (No. 8)：这位2025年德州农工大学总顺位第71顺位的球员本赛季表现出爆发势头，在高阶1A和双A的39.2/3局中投出2.04的防御率和53次三振，直到5月下旬的左肩膀伤势结束了他的常规赛季。伤愈归来后，他仍在秋季联赛中逐渐找回球速，但在用速球抢好球数方面表现极为出色，并展示了两种出色的纵向变化球——曲球（相对较新的球种）和滑球，在4场先发（15.1/3局）中交出3.52的防御率和0.78的WHIP。
底特律老虎：无活跃参赛球员
明尼苏达双城：Kyle DeBarge, UTIL：作为双城在2024年选秀大会上以总顺位第33顺位选中的球员，DeBarge在经历了一个艰难的2026年双A赛季（.221/.335/.352）后，无疑希望抛开脑海中的担忧。他在整个秋季联赛中过得很愉快，其1.094的OPS在联盟中排名第五。
芝加哥白袜：Jonathan Clark, RHP：这位圣何塞州立大学出品的球员在独立先锋联盟效力两个赛季后签约，主要依赖80年代中期的滑球，并穿插92-96英里充满活力的速球。他在7.1/3局中交出3.68的防御率、.111的对手打击率以及11次三振对1次保送的比率。
美国联盟西区

洛杉矶天使：Arjun Nimmala, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 34)：右腿筋问题将Nimmala在2026年的总出场数限制在89场，但在被蓝鸟交易至天使换取José Soriano后，他成为了小联盟中最火热的打者之一，在9月的11场比赛中敲出7支本垒打并拥有.826的长打率，随后在季后赛中又轰出3发本垒打。他在今年秋天的状态有些起伏，但在18场比赛中交出了.301/.446/.507的成绩单。
休斯敦太空人：Jank Pichardo, RHP：从2025年的托马斯约翰手术中恢复过来，Pichardo的防御率为8.74，但在11.1/3局中送出17次三振，在联盟中拥有第四佳的三振率（每9局13.5次）。他在2022年以10,000美元从多米尼加共和国签约，以极其平缓的进垒角度投出92-97英里的速球。
运动家：Davis Diaz, C/INF (No. 19)：作为运动家2024年的第八轮新秀，他刚度过了职业生涯中最棒的一个赛季，晋升至三A并交出双位数的本垒打与盗垒，同时总OPS达到.804，在此期间他持续在球场各处移动并学习捕手的细微技巧。他今年秋天专注于捕手位置的工作，同时维持着出色的打击手感，在12场比赛中交出.302/.436/.442的打击三围。
Kenya Huggins, RHP (No. 23)：在2025年交易截止日从红人队交易而来，Huggins正在摆脱在运动家体系中极其起伏的首个完整赛季（防御率6.63），在梅萨队的牛棚中投球。凭借最高可达99英里的速球以及触及90-91英里的类卡特滑球，他在5次出场中交出2.16的防御率和每9局11.9次三振的出色秋季联赛成绩。
西雅图水手：Adam Smith, RHP：Smith的职业生涯充满曲折，他于2021年以教士第14轮选秀开启职业生涯。在2023赛季结束后被教士释出，他以自由球员身份与红袜签约，但在两个赛季后再次成为小联盟自由球员。这位伸卡-滑球后援投手今年从独立联盟开始，但在5月与水手签约，在26岁时一路从高阶1A投到双A。

得克萨斯游骑兵：Sebastian Walcott, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 8)：作为秋季联赛中排名最高的潜力新秀，Walcott以其远高于平均水平的原始长打火力和臂力脱颖而出。在2月接受内支架手术恢复而错过了大部分小联盟赛季后，他重新回到游击防区，也可能会担任一些外野守备。他在2023年以320万美元从巴哈马签约，在13场比赛中交出.316/.369/.474的打击三围，并有9次盗垒。
Paxton Kling, OF (No. 20)：作为一名具备“25轰-25盗”潜力的中外野手，Kling拥有游骑兵体系中最全面的身手之一，但在路易斯安那州大和宾夕法尼亚州大效力期间，打击的不稳定性导致他在2025年选秀中滑落至第七轮。他在14场比赛中交出.364/.478/.455的打击率，并有13次盗垒。
Julian Brock, C：Brock具备出色的原始长打火力但缺乏稳定的击球率，并在本垒板后方提供具备强力臂力的不错防守。这位来自路易斯安那拉斐特分校的2023年第八轮新秀在13场比赛中交出.211/.426/.263的打击率，获得14次保送。
Alejandro Chiquillo, RHP：在2024年以5,000美元从哥伦比亚签约，Chiquillo拥有94-96英里且最快可达98英里的速球以及80年代中期的滑球。他在14.2/3局中投出5.52的防御率和16次三振。
订阅 MLB Pipeline 通讯
国家联盟东区
亚特兰大勇士：Tate Southisene, SS/2B (No. 3/MLB No. 58)：作为勇士2025年的首轮新秀，Southisene在首个完整赛季中一路从单A升至双A，超出了预期，在90场比赛中交出.875的OPS。一次触身球导致他在首场双A比赛中手腕骨折，但这位内野手在秋季联赛中延续了之前的火热状态，在13场比赛中交出.341/.482/.432的成绩单。

Briggs McKenzie, LHP (No. 8)：勇士在2025年选秀中砸下远超标准的资金从北卡罗来纳州高中签下McKenzie，在第四轮给予他近300万美元的签约金。他在2026年迎来火热开局，迅速升至高阶1A罗马队，但左前臂神经发炎使他今年仅投了26局便长期作壁上观。他今年秋天有过两次糟糕的登板（13局失13分自责分，5.1/3局），但在其余15.1/3局的投球中仅失2分自责分，其中包括周四投出4局无失分。
迈阿密马林鱼：Dillon Lewis, OF (No. 11)：作为去年1月与洋基队Ryan Weathers交易的一部分，Lewis正寻求成为皇后学院第一位大联盟球员。他结合了出色的原始长打火力和速度，在15场比赛中交出.283/.333/.433的打击率。
纽约大都会：Irving Cota, RHP：Cota在2023年以19岁之龄从墨西哥以10,000美元签约，两年后便晋升至双A层级。他以低四分之三的出手点投出一套东西向的球路组合，其中以92-95英里的伸卡球和84-86英里的变速球最为突出，两者皆有显著的臂侧尾劲。尽管球路会位移，但他拥有出色的控球能力，在今年秋季12.2/3局的后援投球中送出15次三振，仅有3次保送。
Ryan Lambert, RHP：Lambert本可以在今年夏天利用他近90英里中后段的卡特-上飘速球争取进入纽约的大联盟牛棚，但控球问题和右前臂屈肌伤势拖慢了他的脚步。他在惊奇队重新找回了状态，在6局无失分、无安打的投球中送出10次三振和4次保送，同时加入了一个较长的滑球来搭配其快速球和较短的变化球。
Teo Banks, OF：在常规赛效力高阶1A威尔明顿的92场比赛中交出.251打击率、6支本垒打和90的wRC+后，Banks充分利用了秋季联赛的聚光灯，在为盐河队出战的21场比赛中交出.366/.413/.620的打击三围和9支长打，并轮流镇守三个外野位置。
Kevin Bazzell, C：Bazzell在周三以14场比赛1.169的数值成为秋季联赛OPS领跑者。在此期间，他的37个打数中敲出14支安打（打击率.378），包含2支本垒打、4支二垒安打、7次保送和仅4次三振。对于一位在4月至5月期间因头部遭触身球击中而缺阵近一个月的捕手来说，这是一次强劲的回归。

华盛顿国民：Jarlin Susana, RHP (No. 4/MLB No. 66)：如果苏珊娜在周日登板，他肯定会带来火球；他包办了今年秋季联赛球速最快的65球，最快球速达到103.8英里。他80年代中期的曲球为他的四缝线和伸卡球之外提供了另一个极品武器，他还在今年秋天致力于增加横扫滑球和卡特球。这位身高6尺6寸的右投手在从去年的背阔肌手术康复缺阵后，以在18.2/3局中送出26次三振领跑秋季联赛。
费城费城人：Aidan Miller, 3B/SS (No. 2/MLB No. 59)：在因背部问题缺席了几乎整个2026赛季后，人们最想看到的是健康的Miller。在重返赛场帮助雷丁赢得双A东区联盟冠军后，Miller今年秋天表现惊艳，打击三围为.333/.562/.500，有6次盗垒，并且在职业生涯首次长时间镇守三垒时显得游刃有余。
国家联盟中区
密尔沃基酿酒人：Eric Bitonti, 1B/3B (No. 26)：这位20岁的内野手身高6尺5寸，体格壮硕，在职业生涯第二个完整赛季在高阶1A和双A敲出25支本垒打，证明了自己具备相匹配的长打潜力。这位左打重炮今年秋天在为斯科茨达尔出战的15场比赛中交出.275/.383/.451的打击率，并追加了2支本垒打，不过他的三振率也达到了31.7%，延续了其年轻职业生涯中的另一个特点。
Matthew Wood, C：Wood展现了出色的纪律性和改良的击球角度，在常规赛效力双A比洛克的95场比赛中交出.398的上垒率、职业生涯新高的18支本垒打以及52/71的三振/保送比。面对休赛期的规则五选秀资格，他无疑将这些出色的挥棒决策带到了斯科茨达尔，在秋季联赛的12场比赛中交出.489的上垒率和6/13的三振/保送比，同时分摊捕手和指定打击工作。
圣路易斯红雀：Tai Peete, OF (No. 17)：在今年夏天因病缺阵后，Peete成为了整个秋季联赛中最具活力和能量的球员之一，在16场比赛过后，以11支长打、41个垒打数和13次盗垒跻身联盟前三。在此期间，他交出.328/.410/.612的打击率，展现了长打与速度兼备的组合，如果他能提升击球率，未来有望在大联盟成为至少“25轰-25盗”的威胁。
芝加哥小熊：Kade Snell, OF：作为2025年选秀大会上凭借进攻表现、数据和综合素质备受瞩目的大学大四潜力新秀之一，Snell在第五轮被阿拉巴马大学选中。他在17场比赛中交出.286/.438/.381的打击三围，有9次盗垒。
匹兹堡海盗：Wyatt Sanford, SS/2B (No. 5)：作为海盗2024年的第二轮新秀，Sanford在职业生涯的第二个完整赛季实现了巨大飞跃，尤其是在打击爆发力方面，在77场比赛中轰出19支本垒打外加33次盗垒。他因手部受伤缺阵了近两个月，这让他错失了升上双A的机会。目前仍有一些挥空问题需要解决，但在今年秋天的15场比赛中，他敲出了4支长打，OPS达到.803。

辛辛那提红人：Luke Holman, RHP：红人很高兴在2024年选秀第二轮从路易斯安那州大选中Holman，但这确实是他们第一次长期近距离观察他的实战表现。导致托马斯约翰手术的肘部问题将他的前两个职业生涯总投球局数限制在仅15.2/3局，但他一直是秋季联赛中最出色的投手之一，以.114的对手打击率领跑联盟，并凭借四种球路的组合在防御率（0.69）上排名第二，在13局投球中以每9局13.9次的三振率排名第三。
Yerlin Confidan, OF：他的选球策略仍有待改善（在13场秋季联赛中有15次三振对3次保送），但具备多项身手的Confidan是今年秋天最令人惊喜的发现之一。他创下了联盟中几项最佳的击球初速，并以10支长打并列第四，这转化为1.053的OPS，排名第八佳。
国家联盟西区
亚利桑那响尾蛇：Demetrio Crisantes, 2B (No. 1/MLB No. 84)：作为小联盟生涯打击率.312的球员，这位亚利桑那本地人整个职业生涯都在与伤病作斗争，最近一次是在今年春训结束后遭遇腿筋问题。他依然拥有出色的击球技巧，有望在2027年争取一个响尾蛇内野位置，并在今年秋天为盐河出战时展现了速度，在7次盗垒尝试中全部成功。
Joe Ariola, LHP：这位2025年从维克森林大学通过第七轮选秀选中的球员是小联盟中最有效率的左代救援投手之一，在单A、高阶1A和双A的34.2/3局中交出1.56的防御率、1.04的WHIP和64次三振。这样的表现延续到了秋季联赛（6.1/3局中失2分自责分，9次三振），这归功于他运用93-95英里且具极佳尾劲的四缝线速球和78-81英里的曲球来主导高低球路。
洛杉矶道奇：Chase Harlan, 3B (No. 9)：作为棒球界顶尖的三垒潜力新秀之一，Harlan具备远超标准的原始长打火力和热区所需的强力臂力。作为2024年从宾夕法尼亚州高中选出的第三轮新秀，他在16场比赛中交出.276/.403/.586的打击三围，带有5支本垒打。
Brooks Auger, RHP (No. 28)：Auger在密西西比州大主要担任后援投手，期间因托马斯约翰手术导致2023年赛季报销，随后在次年被选为第六轮新秀，如今他已成为一名拥有爆发力的90年代中期速球和犀利的80年代中期滑球的五球种先发投手。他在11.1/3局中投出7.15的防御率和13次三振。
Luke Fox, LHP：在2023年第17轮被选中时，他因托马斯约翰手术错过了在杜克大学的整个大三赛季，Fox能够很好地掌控他92-96英里的速球和80年代初期的滑球。他在11局中交出4.09的防御率，送出14次三振。
旧金山巨人：Dalton Wentz, 3B：作为秋季联赛中仅有的两名2026年选秀球员之一（另一位是皇家首轮秀Zion Rose），Wentz作为从维克森林大学选出的第16轮新秀，以584,955美元（第四轮的资金）签约。作为一名左右开弓的打者，至少具备远超标准的原始长打火力和扎实的臂力，他在14场比赛中交出.313/.436/.531的打击三围。
圣迭戈教士：Kannon Kemp, RHP (No. 13)：Kemp在去年为皮奥里亚效力后重返秋季联赛，原因是左斜肌受伤将他夏天的投球局数限制在38.2/3局，他展现了出色的球速，伸卡球和四缝线速球都在96-98英里左右。他的88-91英里变速球拥有与伸卡球相似的位移但速度落差明显，是他的教士最佳变化球种，对皮奥里亚的挥空率达到35%。
Alex McCoy, OF (No. 26)：在今年秋季联赛梯队中，论纯长打火力，McCoy难逢敌手，他在两支本垒打中创造了今年秋季116.3英里和118.2英里的三项击球初速中的两项。这位身高6尺5寸重炮手在皮奥里亚的15支安打中有10支是长打（5支本垒打，5支二垒安打），尽管三振是个问题，但他在66个打席中交出.283/.409/.660的打击三围。
科罗拉多洛矶：Jared Thomas, OF (No. 10)：Thomas在去年秋季联赛结束后接受了钩骨手术，随后又需要进行手术切除骨刺，这让他缺席了大部分2026年赛季。三振问题仍然存在（72个打数吞下29K），但他摆脱了今年秋天的慢热，记录了一波7场比赛的安打串联，将整体打击三围提升至令人印象深刻的.319/.430/.556。
Jack O’Dowd, C：作为前总经理兼现任MLB Network球评Dan O’Dowd的儿子（他将有机会在秋季明星赛转播中播报自己儿子的比赛），Jack已从独立联盟签约的好奇对象转变为货真价实的潜力新秀。他在第一年跨越三个层级轰出23支本垒打并交出.564的长打率，并证明这绝非侥幸，在秋季联赛中以6支本垒打和.687的长打率领跑全联盟。
Fidel Ulloa, RHP：作为洛杉矶路易斯安那州大2024年的第七轮新秀，这位前选秀联盟参赛者在2026年为双A哈特福德后援时度过了稳健的一年。他是秋季联赛中最出色的牛棚投手之一，在7次登板中未失分数，每9局三振11.0次，速球最高可达96英里，并配有一颗特别有效的变速球。

items.titleEn: Here are the rosters for Sunday's AFL Fall Stars Game
bodyEn: In last year’s Arizona Fall League Fall Stars Game, Kevin McGonigle led off for the American League, Hagen Smith struck out a pair in a scoreless inning of relief and Sam Antonacci picked up two RBIs, including the game-winner on a walk-off sacrifice fly in the ninth inning of the AL’s 5-4 victory over the National League at Mesa’s Sloan Park. Less than a year later, all three made significant impacts as bonafide Major Leaguers in the AL Central.
This Sunday, we’ll see who can follow in their footsteps to The Show.

The Arizona Fall League announced the American and National League Fall Stars Game rosters, which included 10 of MLB Pipeline’s Top 100 prospects, on Wednesday. The 20th annual showcase event will be broadcast live from Salt River Fields at Talking Stick on MLB Network and streamed on MLB.com with Paul Severino, Dan O’Dowd and Jim Callis calling the action at 8 p.m. ET (6 p.m. local time).

The American League squad has six of the 10 active Top 100 talents on its roster -- Rangers shortstop Sebastian Walcott (No. 8), Angels shortstop Arjun Nimmala (No. 34), Rays catcher Nathan Flewelling (No. 63), Royals outfielder Angeibel Gomez (No. 76), Yankees shortstop Dax Kilby (No. 78) and Orioles outfielder/first baseman Ike Irish (No. 95). The remaining four on the National League side are Braves infielder Tate Southisene (No. 58), Phillies infielder Aidan Miller (No. 59), Nationals right-hander Jarlin Susana (No. 66) and D-backs second baseman Demetrio Crisantes (No. 84).

Two other Top 100 prospects -- Tigers outfielder Zyhir Hope (No. 26) and White Sox infielder/outfielder Caleb Bonemer (No. 27) -- were officially named AL Fall Stars but won’t participate after their earlier exits from Fall League play.

Among the other notable Fall Stars on initial rosters are Guardians middle infielder Welbyn Francisca, who leads the AFL in average (.409) and is second in slugging (.667) and OPS (1.134); 2026 sixth overall pick and Royals outfielder Zion Rose and Padres outfielder Alex McCoy, who is tied for second on the circuit with five homers and has its highest exit velocity this season at 118.2 mph.

Six players still have a chance to make the contest through The Fall Stars Final 2 Vote. Royals catcher Brooks Bryan, Angels third baseman Jake Munroe and Yankees first baseman Kyle West are competing for the last AL spot, while Dodgers second baseman/outfielder Charles Davalan, Padres infielder Justin DeCriscio and Dodgers outfielder Eduardo Quintero are up for the NL. Quintero (No. 15) or Davalan (No. 79) would add another Top 100 talent to the proceedings. Fans can vote on MLB.com and the Fall League website until voting closes at 8 p.m. ET/6 p.m. MT on Friday.

AFL skippers Daniel Robertson (Surprise) and Rafael Neda (Scottsdale) will manage the AL and NL teams respectively. Robertson worked as a Guardians assistant baserunning coordinator and Triple-A Columbus bench coach before heading to the desert, while Neda manages the Brewers’ Rookie-level Arizona Complex League affiliate.

items.titleZh: 亚利桑那秋季联赛全明星赛阵容公布
items.summaryZh: 亚利桑那秋季联赛公布了本周日全明星赛的美联与国联阵容，其中包括多位百大潜力新秀。
bodyZh: 在去年的亚利桑那秋季联赛全明星赛中，Kevin McGonigle为美国联盟担任开路先锋，Hagen Smith在1局无失分的后援投球中送出2次三振，Sam Antonacci则贡献2分打点，其中包括在9局下半敲出再见高飞牺牲打，助美联以5比4击败国家联盟（比赛在梅斯的Sloan公园举行）。不到一年后，这三人都在美联中区作为真正的大联盟球员产生了重大影响。
本周日，我们将看看谁能步他们的后尘登上大联盟舞台。
亚利桑那秋季联赛于周三公布了美联与国联全明星赛的参赛阵容，其中包括10位MLB Pipeline评选的百大潜力新秀。第20届年度表演赛将于美东时间晚上8点（当地时间下午6点）在Talkative球场的Salt River Fields现场直播，MLB Network进行电视转播，MLB.com进行网络直播，由Paul Severino、Dan O'Dowd和Jim Callis担任解说。

美联阵容中拥有10位现役百大新秀中的6位：得克萨斯游骑兵游击手Sebastian Walcott（第8位）、洛杉矶天使游击手Arjun Nimmala（第34位）、坦帕湾光芒捕手Nathan Flewelling（第63位）、堪萨斯城皇家外野手Angeibel Gomez（第76位）、纽约洋基游击手Dax Kilby（第78位）以及巴尔的摩金莺外野手/一垒手Ike Irish（第95位）。国联阵营的其余4人则是亚特兰大勇士内野手Tate Southisene（第58位）、费城费城人内野手Aidan Miller（第59位）、华盛顿国民右投手Jarlin Susana（第66位）以及亚利桑那响尾蛇二垒手Demetrio Crisantes（第84位）。
另外两位百大潜力新秀——底特律老虎外野手Zyhir Hope（第26位）和芝加哥白袜内野手/外野手Caleb Bonemer（第27位）——虽然官方被命名为美联全明星，但由于此前已退出秋季联赛的比赛，因此将不会参赛。
在初始阵容的其他知名全明星球员中，克利夫兰守护者二游防线球员Welbyn Francisca在秋季联赛中以.409的打击率领跑，长打率（.667）和OPS（1.134）均名列第二；2026年首轮第六顺位新秀、堪萨斯城皇家外野手Zion Rose，以及圣迭戈教士外野手Alex McCoy（他以5支本垒打并列联盟第二，并创下本赛季118.2英里/小时的最高击球初速）。

目前仍有6名球员有机会通过“最后两席投票”争夺参赛资格。堪萨斯城皇家捕手Brooks Bryan、洛杉矶天使三垒手Jake Munroe和纽约洋基一垒手Kyle West正在争夺最后一个美联名额，而洛杉矶道奇二垒手/外野手Charles Davalan、圣迭戈教士内野手Justin DeCriscio和洛杉矶道奇外野手Eduardo Quintero则在竞逐国联名额。Quintero（第15位）或Davalan（第79位）若当选，将为阵容再添一位百大新秀。球迷可以在MLB.com和秋季联赛官网上投票，投票将于美东时间周五晚上8点/山地时间下午6点截止。
秋季联赛的主教练Daniel Robertson（Surprise队）和Rafael Neda（Scottsdale队）将分别执教美联和国联队伍。Robertson在前往沙漠之前曾担任守护者队的助理跑垒协调员和3A哥伦布队的替补教练，而Neda则执掌密尔沃基酿酒人队新人联盟亚利桑那综合联盟分支机构的帅印。

items.titleEn: Blue Jays' Parker goes from last-minute sub to Fall League HR Derby champ
bodyEn: SCOTTSDALE, Ariz. -- Blue Jays outfielder/catcher Aaron Parker was enjoying his Friday night off after playing an Arizona Fall League day game, watching a movie with teammates when his phone rang at 10:30 p.m.
Chase Harlan (LAD No. 9) had to pull out of the AFL Home Run Derby scheduled for the next evening. Might Parker be interested in taking his place?

"I said, yeah, of course," Parker said. "It's an amazing experience, so it was a no-brainer for me. I had to tell my dad, 'We're not going out to dinner. We're going to go try to hit as many home runs as possible.'"
Parker hit enough to win the entire event. He needed just three swings to best Tai Peete (STL No. 17), 2-1, in the finals, capping his day with a 477-foot shot to left-center field.

Though Parker never had participated in a home run derby before, he's a natural. He hits balls harder than almost any player in the Minors, with his 90th percentile exit velocities averaging 107.9 mph this season to rank in the top 1 percent.

Parker didn't have an easy path to victory. First he had to face Alex McCoy (SD No. 26), who might be the most physically imposing player in the Fall League at 6-foot-5, 260 pounds. McCoy hit the longest ball of the day, a 503-foot shot, but Parker defeated him, 12-7, and tied Rockies catcher Jack O'Dowd for the most homers in the first round.

That set up a semifinal matchup against Royals catcher Brooks Bryan, who batted first and homered five times. Parker went deep just once in his first five swings before calling timeout, then added just one homer in his next four tries. Down to his final two outs, he rallied with three mammoth blasts to advance to the finals.

"Just never take your foot off the gas," said Parker, a 2024 sixth-rounder from UC Santa Barbara who's slashing .356/.483/.511 in 12 games for the Mesa Solar Sox. "I hit one homer dead-center and I kind of felt something go right with my swing. So I was like, all right, took a deep breath, got back in the box and went back to work."

Peete was on a roll heading into the finals. He didn’t use any of his nine outs while vanquishing Eric Bitonti (MIL No. 26), 9-8, in the first round, and he had four outs remaining when he dispatched O'Dowd, 4-3, in the second round. But he only delivered once in the finals to fall to Parker.

"This is awesome," said Parker, whose longest drive traveled 497 feet. "Throughout the day, you're thinking about it and you're like, OK, if I swing and miss, you know, it's no big deal. Or if I don't hit any homers, it's no big deal. It was just coming out here with no expectations and understanding that the group of guys around you is going to lift you up to their playing field as well."

items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟外野手/捕手Aaron Parker临时替补参加亚利桑那秋季联盟本垒打大赛并最终夺冠。
bodyZh: 亚利桑那州斯科茨代尔——多伦多蓝鸟外野手/捕手Aaron Parker在打完一场亚利桑那秋季联盟的日场比赛后，正享受着周五的假期与队友看电影，这时他的手机在晚上10:30响了。
Chase Harlan（洛杉矶道奇第9号潜力新秀）不得不退出原定于次日晚上举行的秋季联盟本垒打大赛。Parker是否有兴趣顶替他的位置？
“我说，好啊，当然，”Parker说。“这是一次神奇的经历，所以对我来说不用考虑。我不得不告诉我父亲，‘我们不出去吃晚饭了。我们要去试着尽可能多地打出本垒打。’”
Parker击出的本垒打足以让他赢得整个赛事。在决赛中，他仅用三次挥棒就以2比1战胜了Tai Peete（圣路易斯红雀第17号潜力新秀），并以一记飞向左中外野477英尺的击球为自己的一天画上了圆满句号。
尽管Parker以前从未参加过本垒打大赛，但他极具天赋。他击球的力度比小联盟中几乎任何球员都要强，本赛季他第90百分位数的平均击球初速达到107.9英里/小时，跻身前1%。
Parker的夺冠之路并不轻松。首先他必须面对Alex McCoy（圣迭戈教士第26号潜力新秀），身高6英尺5英寸、体重260磅的他是秋季联盟中体格最威猛的球员之一。McCoy打出了当天最远的一记503英尺的击球，但Parker以12比7击败了他，并在第一轮比赛中与科罗拉多洛矶捕手Jack O'Dowd并列击出最多本垒打。
这造就了与堪萨斯城皇家捕手Brooks Bryan的半决赛对决，后者率先上场并打出了五支本垒打。Parker在叫暂停前的前五次挥棒中仅深远击出一记，随后在接下来四次尝试中又添一记本垒打。在只剩最后两个出局数的情况下，他凭借三记超远本垒打绝地反击，晋级决赛。
“永远不要放松油门，”Parker说，他是来自加州大学圣巴巴拉分校的2024年第六轮新秀，目前在梅萨太阳袜队效力的12场比赛中交出了.356/.483/.511的打击三围。“我打出一记正中中外野的本垒打，我感觉自己的挥棒状态完全对了。所以我当时想，好吧，深吸一口气，回到打击区，重新开始工作。”

Peete进入决赛时状态正佳。他在第一轮以9比8战胜Eric Bitonti（密尔沃基酿酒人第26号潜力新秀）时没有用掉九个出局数中的任何一个，并且在第二轮以4比3淘汰O'Dowd时还剩四个出局数。但在决赛中他仅击中一次，输给了Parker。

items.titleEn: How aggressive should Blue Jays be in fortifying 2027 rotation?
bodyEn: TORONTO -- The Blue Jays belong in the conversation for every top-end free agent, regardless of price. This offseason, that list begins with Tarik Skubal, one of the most dominant pitchers in the sport.

This organization is spending more than it ever has, enough to shake the “runner-up” tag which had been lazily slapped on them over the years. On top of Dylan Cease’s $210 million deal and Vladimir Guerrero Jr.’s $500 million mega-contract, they spent the two prior offseasons going deep on both Shohei Ohtani and Juan Soto.

The Blue Jays sit at the adults table, alongside the Dodgers, Phillies, Mets, Yankees and a few others. They have an “anything is possible” payroll, and they’ve shown they’re perfectly willing to pay for pitching, from Cease to Kevin Gausman and José Berríos.
With significant needs in their lineup, however, where Seiya Suzuki looks like a perfect match on paper, how aggressive should the Blue Jays be in their rotation?
What they’re working with
If the season started tomorrow, it’s: Dylan Cease, Trey Yesavage, José Soriano, Cody Ponce and potentially Spencer Miles, who is expected to convert from the bullpen.

This is a good starting point, but the group needs a higher ceiling and floor, especially after we saw the extent of injuries in 2026. Some of that will come internally, too, with a list of prospects that includes the following arms ending 2026 in Double-A or above: Nolan Perry (No. 2), Johnny King (No. 3), Gage Stanifer (No. 9), Jake Bloss (No. 11), Danny Thompson Jr. (No. 14), Daniel Guerra (No. 15), Chad Dallas (No. 22), John Klein (No. 29).

Add in Bowden Francis and Berríos, who are rehabbing from Tommy John and could return later in the season, and the Blue Jays have plenty of options here. They’re still eager to add established big-league talent, though, and that won’t come cheap.
Starting at the top: Skubal and Peralta

The MLB record for a pitcher’s annual salary is $43.3 million, which both Max Scherzer and Justin Verlander have hit. Skubal is positioned well to take a run at that number, which launches well beyond the $30 million annual salary they’re paying Cease.

The Blue Jays’ books look good, which is important to establish here. Beyond Cease and Guerrero, they don’t have any other massive commitments into the future, and there’s hope an improved farm system can help to supply depth more consistently. Broadly speaking, it’s felt like the Blue Jays prefer to stick with more traditional deals, which could land near eight years for Skubal, instead of the short-term, big-money deals which have become more popular recently.

Expect the Blue Jays to be involved on Skubal, because that’s the default by now. He’ll be 30 next season, owns two Cy Young Awards and his ERA has started with a two each of the past four seasons. He’s a true ace, elite by every definition of the word, but will the Blue Jays outbid the Dodgers and Mets here? A mid-range starter with more significant offensive upgrades could be the more valuable play.

Freddy Peralta is another name to consider, fresh off a run to the World Series with the Rays. Two months ago, before his incredible stretch run, Peralta lined up as a perfect bounce-back candidate for the Blue Jays with his durability and track record, but his price tag has skyrocketed.
More realistically: The mid-range options

The bargain bin doesn’t make much sense for Toronto, at least not until the annual depth signings closer to camp. This team still needs to have World Series expectations, and they don’t just need innings, they need high-end pitching.

Japanese righty Kaima Taira cracks that list, especially given the uncertainty around where his guaranteed money will land and his age at just 27, but the mid-range market is well-stocked with short-term options. If the Blue Jays don’t swing big on Skubal, they’d be wise to find “their guy” out of this group on a two- or three-year deal, similar to Chris Bassitt’s time in Toronto.

Old friend Gausman tops that list, if the Blue Jays are confident their former ace still has something in the tank, while Tyler Mahle is intriguing and has drawn their interest in the past. Sonny Gray, Foster Griffin and Shota Imanaga won’t wow you with the radar gun or their strikeout rates, but going back to Bassitt, the Blue Jays have been attracted to veterans with deep pitch mixes before.
The Blue Jays’ pitching development has made some great strides in the past 18 months, but that takes time, and a short-term veteran could be the perfect bridge to that.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟应多大程度积极补强2027年先发轮值？
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟在自由球员市场上极具竞争力，他们需要在阵容需求与先发轮值补强之间做出权衡。
bodyZh: 多伦多州 -- 无论价格如何，蓝鸟队都跻身于每一位顶级自由球员的讨论行列中。这个休赛期，这份名单从Tarik Skubal开始，他是这项运动中最具统治力的投手之一。
这支球队的支出创下了历史新高，足以摆脱这些年来被强加的“第二名”标签。除了Dylan Cease的2.1亿美元合同和Vladimir Guerrero Jr.的5亿美元超级合同外，他们在前两个休赛期还深入追逐了大谷翔平和Juan Soto。
蓝鸟队与道奇、费城人、大都会、洋基等球队平坐成人桌。他们的薪资总额达到了“一切皆有可能”的水平，并且他们已经表现出完全愿意为从Cease到Kevin Gausman和José Berríos的投手支付薪水。
然而，由于他们的阵容有重大需求（其中Seiya Suzuki在纸面上看起来是绝佳人选），蓝鸟队在轮值方面应该表现得多么积极呢？
他们目前的现有阵容
如果明天赛季开始，先发阵容将是：Dylan Cease、Trey Yesavage、José Soriano、Cody Ponce，以及预计将从牛棚转型的Spencer Miles。

这是一个很好的起点，但这个组合需要更高的上限和下限，特别是在我们看到2026年伤病情况的程度之后。其中一部分也将来自内部，2026赛季结束时在双A或更高水平的潜力新秀投手名单包括：Nolan Perry（第2名）、Johnny King（第3名）、Gage Stanifer（第9名）、Jake Bloss（第11名）、Danny Thompson Jr.（第14名）、Daniel Guerra（第15名）、Chad Dallas（第22名）、John Klein（第29名）。
再加上正在从汤米·约翰手术中恢复、可能会在赛季晚些时候回归的Bowden Francis和Berríos，蓝鸟队在这里有很多选择。不过，他们仍然渴望引进成熟的大联盟天赋，而这并不便宜。
从顶尖球员开始：Skubal与Peralta
投手年薪的MLB纪录是4330万美元，Max Scherzer和Justin Verlander都达到过这一数字。Skubal很有希望冲击这一数字，这远远超过他们目前支付给Cease的3000万美元年薪。
蓝鸟队的财务状况看起来不错，这一点在这里确立很重要。除了Cease和Guerro之外，他们在未来没有任何其他巨额承诺，人们希望不断改善的农场系统能够更持续地提供深度。广义而言，蓝鸟队似乎更倾向于坚持更传统的合同，对于Skubal来说可能接近八年，而不是最近变得更受欢迎的短期、大合同。
预计蓝鸟队会参与到Skubal的争夺中，因为这已经是默认情况了。他下赛季将年满30岁，拥有两次赛扬奖，并且过去四个赛季的自责分率都以2开头。他是一名真正的王牌，用这个词的每个定义来衡量都是精英级别的，但蓝鸟队能出价超过道奇队和大都会队吗？拥有更多显著进攻升级的中档先发投手可能是更有价值的选择。
Freddy Peralta是另一个需要考虑的名字，他刚刚随光芒队打入世界大赛。两个月前，在他令人难以置信的冲刺阶段之前，Peralta凭借他的耐用性和履历，对蓝鸟队来说是一个完美的触底反弹候选人，但他的身价已经飙升。
更现实的选择：中档选项
对多伦多来说，淘宝捡漏并没有太大意义，至少在训练营临近时的年度深度签约之前是这样。这支球队仍然需要具备世界大赛的期望，他们不仅需要投球局数，还需要高水平的投手。
日本右投Kaima Taira进入了这份名单，考虑到他的保障薪资最终会落在哪里的不确定性以及他年仅27岁的年龄，但中档市场充斥着短期选项。如果蓝鸟队没有对Skubal进行大笔引援，他们明智的做法是从这个群体中以两年或三年的合同找到“他们的球员”，类似于Chris Bassitt在多伦多的时期。
如果蓝鸟队确信他们昔日的王牌还有油水，老朋友Gausman将名列这份名单之首，而Tyler Mahle则很引人注目，过去曾吸引过他们的兴趣。Sonny Gray、Foster Griffin和Shota Imanaga不会用测速枪或三振率惊艳到你，但回顾Bassitt，蓝鸟队以前就对拥有丰富投球组合的老将感兴趣。
蓝鸟队的投手培养在过去18个月里取得了很大进步，但这需要时间，而短期的老将可能是通往这一目标的完美桥梁。

items.titleEn: Here's why Seiya should make Toronto his next home
bodyEn: This story was excerpted from Keegan Matheson’s Blue Jays Beat newsletter. To read the full newsletter, click here. And subscribe to get it regularly in your inbox.
TORONTO -- If you were a professional matchmaker, you’d want to set up Seiya Suzuki and the Blue Jays on a date. They are, at least on paper, a perfect match.

Whether there’s a spark, that’s for the coming weeks and months to decide, but Suzuki represents everything the Blue Jays are looking for in free agency -- a star-caliber outfielder with the potential to hit 30-plus home runs on top of excellent defense.

This feels like George Springer all over again, such an obvious fit between player, team and need. Prior to 2021, Springer represented the big splash alongside Vladimir Guerrero Jr., Bo Bichette and the young core, a new star to power a team on the rise. Suzuki’s fit is just as obvious, but the Blue Jays have already arrived … and fallen again. All of the flaws exposed in ’26 can so clearly be helped by Suzuki.
Can this work, then, or are we falling to the trap of something that feels too obvious on paper?

On the field: Suzuki is a seamless fitThis organization needs to develop a star outfielder. Until that happens, they’re going to have to keep paying for them (Springer, Anthony Santander) or trading elite prospects for them (Daulton Varsho).

The Blue Jays need to add power to a lineup that ranked dead last in runs scored (648) and homers (152) this year. The easiest place to do that is in the outfield, where Suzuki primarily plays in right, and he checks off all of the defensive boxes that may be shakier with other power bats. Suzuki was worth +7 fielding runs saved a year ago (tied for 17th in MLB) and graded out well above average with his range, jumps and throwing arm.
The simple version: Suzuki’s defensive value rests an inch below that of Nathan Lukes, who is excellent in the field.

Offensively, Suzuki is coming off a season in which he hit .270 with 26 home runs and an .841 OPS, but he also reached base at a .368 clip, rounding out his profile nicely. At 32 years old, though, we need to consider how Suzuki’s bat will age. Springer is a useful example again here, as he struggled at points through his mid-30s before a surprise resurgence in 2025 at age 35. If Suzuki signs a four- or five-year deal, there will likely be some decline involved.

Suzuki’s average exit velocity dipped a bit in 2026 compared to recent seasons with the Cubs, but his average bat speed (73.3 mph) stayed locked in place. His baserunning isn’t a strength, and that’s something the Blue Jays are hyperfocused on, but he’s a quick enough runner (think Ernie Clement’s speed), and the bat should do more than enough to overshadow any issues on the bases.

The dollars: Doable for the Blue JaysEarly projections tend to frame Suzuki’s annual salary in the range of $20 million to $25 million. The line between a fourth and fifth year could be important, too, just as the sixth year was important for Springer.

Financially, there is no issue here for the Blue Jays. Beyond the larger salaries for Guerrero and Dylan Cease, the Blue Jays’ books don’t have much ugly money on them in the coming five years. This team has spent aggressively, too, and Suzuki is well within that reasonable range.
Cubs extend qualifying offer to Suzuki
Keep an eye on Randy Arozarena’s market, too. Whether it’s Arozarena or Suzuki who signs first, one deal will directly impact the other as they exist in their own tier of free-agent outfielders.
The top bat in this free-agent class? These 7 have a case

One big factor: The Japanese marketSuzuki and Kazuma Okamoto have a relationship from their time playing together on Japan’s national team and against one another professionally in Japan when Suzuki starred for Hiroshima. Recruitment won’t be a problem here.

The Blue Jays are also actively looking to expand their presence in the Japanese market. At some road games in 2026, there were more Japanese reporters covering Okamoto than Canadian reporters covering the Blue Jays.

“We’re certainly looking to leverage that from a business perspective as well,” said club CEO and president Mark Shapiro. “Our understanding coming in is that it’s not a one-year process. It takes multiple years. We’re going to have a contingency going over to Japan this offseason. I might make a trip as well, following that up. We hope to have that be part of our business strategy moving forward.”
In the 1970s and ’80s, the Blue Jays had such a strong, valuable presence in Latin America. They’re working to recreate this in Japan and Korea, and Suzuki lines up perfectly, at least on paper.
items.titleZh: 为什么Seiya应该将多伦多作为下一站
items.summaryZh: 分析Seiya Suzuki与多伦多蓝鸟在自由球员市场上的契合度及潜在优势。
bodyZh: 本文摘自Keegan Matheson的Blue Jays Beat新闻通讯。要阅读完整通讯，请点击此处。并订阅以定期将其发送到您的收件箱。
多伦多报道——如果你是一个专业的红娘，你会想为Seiya Suzuki和多伦多蓝鸟安排一次约会。至少在纸面上，他们是绝配。
是否能擦出火花，有待接下来的几周和几个月来决定，但Suzuki代表了多伦多蓝鸟在自由球员市场上寻找的一切——一位球星级的外野手，不仅具备轰出30支以上本垒打的潜力，还拥有出色的防守。

这感觉就像是George Springer的重演，球员、球队和需求之间有着如此明显的契合度。在2021年之前，Springer代表着与Vladimir Guerrero Jr.、Bo Bichette以及年轻核心并肩的大手笔引援，是一位为崛起的球队注入动能的新星。Suzuki的契合度同样显而易见，但多伦多蓝鸟已经经历了崛起……却又再次跌入低谷。26赛季暴露出的所有短板，都可以通过Suzuki得到明显的弥补。
那么，这能行得通吗？还是我们陷入了那种在纸面上看起来过于显而易见的陷阱？
在球场上：Suzuki是不二之选。这个组织需要培养出一名明星外野手。在此之前，他们将不得不继续花钱引进（Springer、Anthony Santander）或用顶级潜力新秀交易来他们（Daulton Varsho）。
多伦多蓝鸟需要为打线注入火力，该队今年在得分（648分）和本垒打（152支）上均排名垫底。最简单的解决办法就是在外野，Suzuki主要镇守右外野，他满足了其他重炮手可能不太稳固的所有防守指标。Suzuki一年前的防守跑分（fielding runs saved）为+7（在MLB并列第17位），其防守范围、起动判断和传球臂力的评分远高于平均水平。
简而言之：Suzuki的防守价值仅比防守极佳的Nathan Lukes略逊一筹。

在进攻端，Suzuki刚刚度过了一个打击率.270、轰出26支本垒打且OPS达到.841的赛季，同时他的上垒率达到了.368，让他的各项数据看起来非常全面。不过在32岁之际，我们需要考虑Suzuki的球棒将如何随着年龄增长而老化。Springer在这里再次成为了一个有用的例子，他在30岁出头时曾一度挣扎，直到2025年35岁时意外迎来了状态复苏。如果Suzuki签下一份四年或五年的合同，很可能会伴随着一些状态的下滑。
与近年效力芝加哥小熊时相比，Suzuki在2026年的平均击球初速略有下降，但他的平均挥棒速度（73.3英里/小时）保持稳定。跑垒并不是他的强项，这也是多伦多蓝鸟高度关注的方面，但他的速度足够快（可以参考Ernie Clement的速度），而他的球棒所带来的贡献足以掩盖任何跑垒上的问题。
资金方面：对多伦多蓝鸟而言完全可行。早期的预测倾向于将Suzuki的年薪定在2000万美元到2500万美元之间。第四年和第五年之间的分水岭可能也很重要，正如第六年对Springer的重要性一样。
在财务上，多伦多蓝鸟对此没有任何问题。除了Guerrero和Dylan Cease的高额薪资外，多伦多蓝鸟在未来五年内的财务账目上并没有多少沉重的包袱。这支球队一直以来都敢于大手笔支出，而Suzuki完全在这个合理的预算范围内。
芝加哥小熊向Suzuki提出资质报价
同时也请密切关注Randy Arozarena的市场行情。无论是Arozarena还是Suzuki率先签约，由于他们处于同一档次的自由球员外野手之列，其中一笔签约将直接影响另一笔。
自由球员市场上的顶级打者？这7人最有希望
一个重大因素：日本市场。Suzuki和Kazuma Okamoto曾在日本国家队并肩作战，并且在日本职业赛场上作为对手时（当时Suzuki效力于广岛）就建立了联系。招募在这里不会成问题。
多伦多蓝鸟也正积极寻求扩大他们在日本市场的版图。在2026年的某些客场比赛中，报道Okamoto的日本记者甚至多于报道多伦多蓝鸟的加拿大记者。
球队首席执行官兼总裁Mark Shapiro表示：“我们当然也希望从商业角度利用这一点。我们目前的理解是，这不是一个一年就能完成的过程。这需要数年的时间。今年休赛期我们将有一个代表团前往日本。随后的时间里，我也可能会亲自前往。我们希望将其作为我们未来商业战略的一部分。”
在20世纪70和80年代，多伦多蓝鸟在拉丁美洲曾拥有如此强大且宝贵的市场影响力。他们目前正努力在日本和韩国复制这一成功，而至少在纸面上，Suzuki与这一战略完美契合。

items.titleEn: Jays' Parker hitting the ball far AND trying out a new position in Fall League
bodyEn: PEORIA, Ariz. -- Peoria Javelinas right-hander Kiefer Lord (Orioles) left a 96-mph fastball over the heart of the plate for Mesa Solar Sox left fielder Aaron Parker on Wednesday afternoon, and he took advantage. The Blue Jays prospect crushed it for a 451-foot home run to left-center field, tied for the fourth-longest in the Arizona Fall League season, powering Mesa to a 14-5 victory.

Parker's blast left his bat at 108.2 mph and showcased what he does at his best. He focuses on driving balls in the air to his pull side, and he hits balls harder than most players in the Minors. He has been one of the most dangerous hitters on the developmental circuit, slashing .357/.481/.524 with two homers in 11 games to earn a berth in Sunday's Fall Stars Game.

While Parker is building on the momentum he generated from a productive season at Double-A (.253/.347/.467 with 19 homers and 12 steals in 87 games), he's doing it at a position that is foreign to him. Before he played three games in left field during the final two weeks of the Eastern League regular season, he never had spent any time in the outfield. He has made six of his AFL starts in left, four at DH and one behind the plate.

Parker joked that his older brother, Ben, played outfield in college at William & Mary, so he figured that it couldn't be too difficult. It's unclear how much he'll balance playing left field with catching going forward, and he's trying to learn as much as he can as quickly as possible.

"2026 is my first time playing outfield," Parker said. "It's still new. Flyball goes up, your heart races a little bit, but you try to keep your wits about you. Stay under control out there and just be an athlete. ​
"Whatever will potentially get me in the lineup is what I'll do. Defense is a huge priority. I'll try to be a skilled player everywhere on the field and just add another tool to the bag."

A 2024 sixth-round pick from UC Santa Barbara, Parker caught the first pitchers drafted in 2025 (Tyler Bremner, Angels) and 2026 (Jackson Flora, Giants). He has solid arm strength but still needs more polish as a receiver and blocker. ​

Parker's right-handed power is the most attractive part of his game and will be his ticket to Toronto. His 19 homers ranked seventh among catchers at Double-A and Triple-A this season and his 90th percentile exit velocities averaged 107.9 mph, which fit in the top 1 percent in the Minors. There's nothing subtle about his approach.

"I just hit it as hard as I can," Parker said. "If you're not erring on the side of being aggressive and trying to get the head out and hitting the good stuff, it can be challenging at times. This year I just leaned into, regardless of the adversity or how good the arms are, just trying to get my best swing off as many times as possible and hopefully good outcomes happen."
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter

While in Arizona, Parker has challenged himself to carry his aggression at the plate to the basepaths. Though he's a well-below-average runner out of the batter's box and only occasionally shows average speed once underway, he has gone 8-for-8 stealing bases after swiping 12 during the regular season.

"If the transition to the outfield is a little bit more permanent, I think it would be really important to steal more bases and try to flash the speed a little bit," Parker said. "So I'm definitely coming out here and testing the spectrum of how many bases I can possibly take as a runner."
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟队Parker在秋季联赛中轰出远距离本垒打并尝试新守位
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟潜力新秀Aaron Parker在秋季联赛中展现强力打击，并正努力学习适应外野守位。
bodyZh: 亚利桑那州皮奥里亚报道——周三下午，皮奥里亚标枪虫队右投手Kiefer Lord（巴尔的摩金莺）投出了一颗时速96英里的直球，正悬挂在好球带中心，梅萨日落索克斯队左外野手Aaron Parker抓住了机会。这位多伦多蓝鸟潜力新秀将球轰向左中外场，飞出451英尺，这并列为亚利桑那秋季联赛本赛季第四远的本垒打，也助力梅萨以14比5取得胜利。
Parker这记击球的初速达到108.2英里/小时，展现了他最佳状态时的水准。他专注于将球击向拉打方向的空中，并且比大多数小联盟球员的击球力度都大。他是发展联盟中最危险的打者之一，在11场比赛中交出了.357/.481/.524的打击三围，并有2支本垒打，从而赢得了周日秋季全明星赛的席位。
正当Parker延续他在2级A表现出色的赛季势头（87场比赛中打击三围.253/.347/.467，有19支本垒打和12次盗垒）时，他却在一个对他而言非常陌生的位置上进行比赛。在此之前，他在东部联盟常规赛最后两周担任过三场左外野手，此前从未在任何外野位置上待过。他在秋季联赛中有6次先发担任左外野手，4次担任指定打击，1次担任捕手。
Parker开玩笑说，他的哥哥Ben曾在威廉与玛丽学院打过外野，所以他觉得这应该不会太难。目前还不清楚他未来将在左外野防守和接捕之间如何平衡，但他正试图尽可能快地学到更多东西。
Parker说：“2026年是我第一次打外野。这依然很新鲜。飞球打向空中时，你的心跳会稍微加速，但你要努力保持冷静。在场上保持掌控，展现运动员的能力。”
Parker说：“任何能让我进入先发阵容的事情我都会去做。防守是重中之重。我会在场上各个位置努力成为一名技术娴熟的球员，为自己再增添一件武器。”
作为2024年选秀自圣巴巴拉加州大学的第六轮新秀，Parker曾接捕过2025年（Tyler Bremner，洛杉矶天使）和2026年（Jackson Flora，旧金山巨人）被选中的投手。他拥有扎实的臂力，但在接球和阻截方面仍需更多打磨。
Parker的右打力量是他比赛中最吸引人的部分，也将成为他通往多伦多的通行证。本赛季他在2级A和3级A的捕手中，19支本垒打排名第七，其击球初速的第90百分位数平均达到107.9英里/小时，跻身小联盟前1%。他的进攻策略直截了当，没有什么含蓄之处。
Parker说：“我就是尽可能用力把球击出去。如果你不倾向于保持积极性、努力将球棒挥出并击中好球，有时就会面临挑战。今年我只是迎难而上，不管面对怎样的逆境或多么优秀的投手，都只求尽可能多次地打出自己最好的挥击，并希望有好的结果发生。”
订阅 MLB 资讯快递
在亚利桑那期间，Parker还挑战自己将打击时的侵略性带到垒包上。尽管他离开打击区时的跑垒速度远低于平均水平，且一旦跑起来后也仅偶尔展现出平均速度，但在常规赛盗垒12次之后，他在秋季联赛中盗垒8次全部成功。
Parker说：“如果转向外野防守变得更加固定，我认为盗垒更多并尝试展现一点速度会非常重要。所以我绝对会来到这里，测试作为一名跑垒员到底能多大程度地推进垒包。”

items.titleEn: How Vladdy can get his groove back in '27
bodyEn: Whenever Vladimir Guerrero Jr. hits a home run, there’s something unique about his trip around the bases. It happens as he’s preparing to round third, and it’s known as the “Vladdy shuffle.”

There’s a specific rhythm to it. It helps that Vlad is a good dancer -- the cadence of the shuffle gives it the desired effect: a final flourish as he prepares to travel the final 90 feet of his latest home run trot.

Unfortunately for Guerrero and the Blue Jays, there weren’t many Vladdy shuffles in 2026. In fact, the six-time All-Star had the poorest offensive season of his career, finishing with a .260/.332/.356 slash line and just nine homers in 609 plate appearances. It wasn't until mid-September that he hit his first home run of the season at Rogers Centre.

Guerrero’s sharp decline was a major reason Toronto followed up a pennant-winning 2025 campaign that brought the Blue Jays two outs from a World Series title and led to aspirations of a return to the Fall Classic in '26, with a last-place finish in the American League East.

Of all the questions the Blue Jays face this offseason, this one is perhaps the biggest, because it seems that as Vlad goes, so go the Jays collectively: Will the club’s $500 million face of the franchise rebound?
Here’s a look at why there’s reason to believe Guerrero will get his groove back:
More time to dance

Guerrero lost his rhythm offensively last season. He got off to a red-hot start -- albeit without his signature power -- over the first month. At the end of April, he had produced a .354/.438/.469 slash line. The power outage (two homers in that span) was certainly eyebrow-raising, but hey, it was only one month into the season.
Then, things got … out of sync. And for Guerrero, whose mechanics at the plate involve meticulous timing with a toe tap and delicate weight transfer, that can spell disaster.

Ask another great slugging first baseman of recent vintage -- Joey Votto. Votto posted on social media in August that he felt one of Guerrero's issues this past season was that "his forward move is delaying his barrel from snapping in place."

In other words, Guerrero tended to drift forward more in 2026, rather than keeping his weight stacked on his back leg until precisely the right moment for transferring his weight forward and using his lead foot to create force with the ground. It often resulted in balls pounded into the ground.
In dance, drifting or swaying is something you do on purpose. At the plate, not so much.

“[Guerrero]'s such a dynamic athlete and hitter that it’s a really complex problem,” Blue Jays general manager Ross Atkins said. “Everyone in here can probably emulate his rhythm and tempo, that toe tap and how he creates that momentum. It’s a really impressive thing to watch.

“As he lost a little bit of that rhythm and timing pretty early in the season, it started to impact his confidence. Once it impacted his confidence, the in-game adjustments and in-season adjustments became very difficult.”

Therein lies the problem when you’re out of whack at the plate during the season: it’s difficult to make adjustments on the fly. There’s always another game tomorrow. Now that it’s the offseason, Guerrero finally has time to breathe. In terms of rhythm at the plate, he can finally “dance” uninterrupted again.

Back in June, with Guerrero mired in what would become the single worst month of his career (.498 OPS), he said that he felt he was going to get hot soon. But what he said also underscored the difficulty of making in-season adjustments -- all you can do is all you can do.

“I’ve been feeling good and I’ve been hitting the ball hard,” Guerrero said. “There’s nothing I can do, I just try to go out there and put a good swing on the ball. I’ve been hitting the ball hard lately, but this is baseball. I’m going to keep working hard and keep doing this.”
Seeing is believing

Following his disappointing 2026 campaign, Guerrero decided to undergo laser eye surgery to sharpen his eyesight, having the procedure performed at the Laser Eye Center of Miami shortly after the end of the regular season.
Other MLB players have also undergone the procedure during their careers, including Guerrero’s former teammate, Bo Bichette.
Prior to the surgery, Guerrero would wear contact lenses during games. Will the laser surgery help? Well, it probably can’t hurt.
The sound of a barrel is music to the ears

As our own Mike Petriello pointed out just prior to the All-Star break, Guerrero’s inexplicable power outage wasn’t due to inordinate bad luck, but rather the fact that he wasn’t barreling the ball nearly as often (his career-low 6.9% barrel rate last season was not much more than half of what it was in 2025 -- 12.2%) and his hard-hit rate was down significantly (from 50.7% in 2025, to 44.3% in ’26). When Guerrero did hit the ball hard, it was frequently on the ground.
When the rhythm and timing of a mechanical sequence at the plate are off, all of that can certainly happen.
Will an offseason to recalibrate and sharper vision at the plate lead to more barrels?

And then there's the macro question: Who is Vladimir Guerrero Jr. at the plate? Is he the 2021 Vlad, who smashed 48 homers and finished runner-up in AL MVP voting? The same Vlad who terrorized opposing pitching during the 2025 postseason, when he slugged .795 with eight homers? Or is he last season’s Vlad, who slugged .356?
Often, the answer to a question like that is: neither; somewhere in between. But it’s unlikely that 2026 Guerrero is the one we see going forward.
It wasn’t all bad
The missing power is the thing. And Guerrero has work to do. But his 2026 campaign did have some silver linings:
His strikeout rate remained elite:

Throughout his career, Guerrero has steadily lowered his strikeout rate. It was good to begin with -- he struck out in 16.4% of his plate appearances over his first four Major League seasons -- but over the past three years, it’s been below 14%. Last season, it was 13.3%, the lowest of his career and ranked among the top 8% of batters.
(Although it should be noted here that he chased a lot more than he usually does, with a career-high 30.6% chase rate in 2026.)
Guerrero’s 20.1% whiff rate during the 2026 campaign was the lowest of his career and ranked in the 76th percentile.
The problem wasn’t contact.
He still has one of the game’s fastest bats:
Guerrero’s average bat speed of 76.3 mph ranked in the 92nd percentile among qualified batters last season, and it was fairly close to what it was during the prior year (76.7).
The problem wasn’t swing speed.
Getting back on the dance floor
It will be fascinating to see how Guerrero performs the next time we see him in the batter’s box during a game.
If the rhythm and flow to his plate mechanics are back, Vladdy will be back, too.
After all, he’s too good for his subpar production to continue indefinitely. And he’ll tell you that, as he did reporters in June.
“Things are going to go my way,” Guerrero said. "At one point, the baseball is going to be good to me.”
items.titleZh: Vladimir Guerrero Jr.如何在2027赛季找回状态
items.summaryZh: 经历2026年低迷赛季后，Vladimir Guerrero Jr.正通过休赛期调整、视力矫正等方式力求在2027年重回巅峰。
bodyZh: 每当Vladimir Guerrero Jr.轰出本垒打，他在垒间的绕垒总有独到之处。这一幕发生在他准备绕过三垒时，被称为“Vladdy shuffle（Vladdy舞步）”。
这其中有着特定的节奏。Vlad擅长跳舞，这种舞步的律动能带来预期的效果：当他准备完成最新一记本垒打巡游的最后90英尺时，展现出华丽的收尾。
但对Guerrero和多伦多蓝鸟而言，不幸的是2026年里这样的舞步并不多见。事实上这位6次入选全明星的球员迎来了职业生涯进攻表现最糟糕的一个赛季，在609个打席中交出了.260/.332/.356的攻击指数，仅敲出9支本垒打。直到9月中旬，他才在罗杰斯中心打出该赛季的个人首支本垒打。
Guerrero的急剧下滑是多伦多在2025年打入美联冠军赛（距离世界大赛冠军仅差两个出局数，并燃起2026年重返秋日经典赛的渴望）之后，最终在美国联盟东区垫底的主要原因。
在多伦多蓝鸟这个休赛期面临的所有疑问中，这或许是最大的一个，因为蓝鸟的整体表现似乎与Vlad息息相关：这位身价5亿美元的球队门面能够反弹吗？
以下是看好Guerrero能够找回状态的原因：
更多跳舞的时间
Guerrero在上个赛季失去了进攻节奏。他在头一个月开局火热——尽管缺乏标志性的长打能力。截至4月底，他的攻击指数为.354/.438/.469。长打输出的短缺（这段期间仅有2支本垒打）确实令人挑眉，但嘿，这毕竟只是赛季的第一个月。
随后，情况变得……不再同步。而对于那些在打击区上的机械动作包含极其讲究的点地抬脚与细腻重心转移的Guerrero来说，这可能意味着灾难。
问问近代的另一位伟大重炮一垒手——Joey Votto。Votto在8月份的社交媒体上发文表示，他认为Guerrero上赛季的问题之一在于“他的前移动作延迟了球棒的反弹到位”。
换句话说，Guerrero在2026年往往会更多地向前漂移，而不是将重心保留在后腿上，直到恰到好处的时刻再将重心向前转移，并用前脚与地面产生力量。这经常导致球被狠狠击向地面。
在舞蹈中，漂移或摇摆是你故意为之的。但在打击区上，可就不是这么回事了。
“（Guerrero）是一名极具动态的运动员和击球手，这是一个非常复杂的问题，”多伦多蓝鸟总经理Ross Atkins表示，“这里的每个人可能都能模仿他的节奏和拍子、那个点地抬脚以及他是如何创造动能的。这真的是一件令人印象深刻的事情。”
“随着他在赛季初失去了一点那种节奏和时机，这开始影响他的自信心。一旦影响了他的自信心，比赛中的调整和赛季中的调整就会变得非常困难。”
这就是赛季中打击节奏失常时的问题所在：很难在比赛进行中随时做出调整。明天总会有另一场比赛。既然现在是休赛期，Guerrero终于有了喘息的时间。就打击区的节奏而言，他终于可以再次毫无干扰地“跳舞”了。
早在6月份时，Guerrero陷入了他职业生涯中单个最差的月份（.498 OPS），他曾表示自己觉得很快就会找回火热手感。但他的言论也凸显了在赛季中进行调整的难处——你能做的也就是你所能做的。
“我一直感觉很好，而且击球很有力，”Guerrero说，“我无能为力，我只是试图走上场去打出好的挥击。我最近击球很有力，但这就是棒球。我会继续努力，继续这样做。”
眼见为实
在经历令人失望的2026赛季后，Guerrero决定接受激光视力手术以提高视力，该手术在常规赛结束后不久于迈阿密激光眼科中心进行。
其他MLB球员在其职业生涯中也接受过该手术，包括Guerrero的前队友Bo Bichette。
在手术之前，Guerrero在比赛中会佩戴隐形眼镜。激光手术会有帮助吗？嗯，它可能不会有什么坏处。
球棒的击球声是悦耳的音乐
正如本站的Mike Petriello在全明星赛前所指出的那样，Guerrero莫名其妙的长打能力消失并不是因为过多的坏运气，而是因为他未能像以前那样频繁地扎实击球（他上赛季创生涯新低的6.9%扎实击球率仅为2025年12.2%的一半左右），且强劲击球率也大幅下降（从2025年的50.7%降至2026年的44.3%）。当Guerrero确实强劲击球时，往往都是滚地球。
当打击区上机械动作的节奏和时机出现偏差时，这一切当然都有可能发生。
一个休赛期的重新校准和更敏锐的打击视线会带来更多的扎实击球吗？
还有一个宏观的问题：打击区上的Vladimir Guerrero Jr.究竟是谁？他是那个在2021年轰出48支本垒打并在美联MVP投票中名列第二的Vlad吗？是那个在2025年季后赛轰出.795长打率并有8支本垒打、令对方投手闻风丧胆的Vlad吗？还是上赛季那个长打率只有.356的Vlad？
通常，面对这样的问题，答案是：两者皆非；居于两者之间。但2026年的Guerrero不太可能是我们未来看到的那个样子。
并非全盘皆墨
长打能力的缺失是关键所在。Guerrero还有很多工作要做。但他的2026赛季确实也有一些亮点：
他的三振率依然保持在精英水准：
在他的职业生涯中，Guerrero稳步降低了他的三振率。一开始就已经很不错了——在他大联盟的前四个赛季中，他的三振率占打席数的16.4%——但在过去三年里，这一数字一直低于14%。上赛季为13.3%，创下他职业生涯新低，并跻身打者前8%。
（尽管这里应该指出，他比平时更多地追打坏球，在2026年创下了30.6%的生涯最高追打率。）
Guerrero在2026赛季20.1%的挥空率是其职业生涯最低，并排在第76百分位。
问题不在于接触球能力。
他仍然拥有全联盟最快的挥棒速度之一：
Guerrero上赛季平均76.3英里/小时的挥棒速度在合格打者中排名第92百分位，这与他前一年（76.7）相当接近。
问题不在于挥棒速度。
重返打击区
看到Guerrero下一次在比赛的打击区中登场时会有怎样的表现，将是非常令人着迷的事情。
如果他打击机械动作的节奏和流畅度回来了，Vladdy也会回来。
毕竟，他实力超群，低迷的表现不会无限期持续下去。他会告诉你这一点，就像他在6月份对记者所说的那样。
“事情会朝着对我有益的方向发展，”Guerrero说，“在某个时刻，棒球会对我好的。”

items.titleEn: Finally healthy, Barriera 'falling in love with' baseball all over again in AFL
bodyEn: MESA, Ariz. -- On the night that Toronto made Brandon Barriera the 23rd pick of the 2022 Draft, he was on top of the world. Attending the event in person, he rushed to hug his dad and boasted the youthful exuberance of a pitcher who had his sights set on a fast track through the Minor Leagues coming out of the Florida high school ranks.
Four years later, he’s much calmer. Barriera has undergone a litany of ailments since the first time he donned a Blue Jays hat:
2023: Elbow, shoulder and biceps issues2024: Combination of Tommy John surgery and an internal brace produce2025: Fractured forearm

But he’s back to wearing the club’s gear in the Arizona Fall League, representing the organization as a member of the Mesa Solar Sox. The time on the sidelines prevented him from doing the thing he grew up loving to do: competing.

“Definitely just a lot of reflecting and really trying to figure out who I am as a player and as a person,” Barriera said. “Most importantly knowing that baseball comes and goes, knowing that my identity can't be in this game because it's a failing game, we all know that.
“But honestly, just falling in love with it all over again, it's been awesome.”

Barriera is quick to credit his strong support system for being integral to keeping him on a continual path back toward the mound. He’s compiled just 66 innings across four pro seasons, but the hesitation and bug of doubt that creeps in when he hurdles his 6-foot-2 frame down the hill toward the batter has finally subsided. He’s still laser-focused on being a big leaguer.

But before he can venture to the Rogers Centre, he first had to make it out of the complex in Dunedin, Fla. It took much longer than anyone could have expected back in July 2022, but on Aug. 23, Barriera earned his first promotion to High-A Vancouver, where he wrapped up his 2026 regular season.

The southpaw worked 38 2/3 innings in total across three levels, again incurring a stint on the injured list due to a non-arm-related issue. He walked batters at too high of a frequency (6.7 BB/9), but struck out better than a batter per inning and ran a 66.7 percent ground-ball rate, the second-highest among all Blue Jays Minor Leaguers (min. 30 IP).

“He's got some unique stuff to him,” Mesa pitching coach Bo Martino, a coordinator of pitching performance in the Angels organization, said of Barriera. “I think a lot of the time [the key] with those guys is not getting away from that uniqueness, building into that. Knowing who you are, building the confidence in yourself, having the mental aspect of just going after guys. I think what's good [in the Fall League] is we want to win games, but we get to develop these guys and set them up for success for the future.”

During his time in the AFL, Barriera has made five appearances, all out of relief. (He departed his most recent outing early on Monday night.) He has scrapped the changeup from his arsenal entirely and his pair of fastballs -- a four-seamer that operates like a cutter and a sinker that gets two-seam action -- have parked around 91-93 mph, maxing out at 94.6. But the star of the show is still the slider, a mid-80s offering that gets a ton of sweep and misses bats; of his six strikeouts for the Solar Sox, four have come on the breaker.

“Honestly, it's evolved a lot. It's definitely a confidence pitch and also just kind of gets a feel back for the heaters,” Barriera said. “I’m trying to rip it like a fastball, tunnel it like a fastball and trust the movement.”

Ultimately, Barriera will spend the entire 2027 season at just 23 years old, giving him ample runway to still impact the big league club one day. The Blue Jays transitioned Ricky Tiedemann (their No. 10 prospect) to a relief role after years of similar setbacks, which ultimately led to an expedited route to The Show.

“When I'm at my best, it's firing on all cylinders and it's competing, giving my team the best chance to win,” he said. “I think that's who I am as a pitcher, whether that's as a starter or as a reliever -- whatever they want to do, I'm going to get it done.”
items.titleZh: 伤愈复出，Barriera在亚利桑那秋季联赛重新爱上棒球
items.summaryZh: 经历多次伤病后，多伦多蓝鸟潜力新秀Barriera在亚利桑那秋季联赛复出，重新找回对棒球的热爱并专注于重返大联盟。
bodyZh: 梅萨，亚利桑那州——在多伦多于2022年选秀大会上以第23顺位选中Brandon Barriera的那天晚上，他正处于人生巅峰。他亲自出席了选秀现场，跑去拥抱他的父亲，展现出了一名年轻投手初出茅庐时的朝气，他当时的目标是从佛罗里达州的高中阵营出发，在小联盟中实现极速晋升。
四年后，他变得冷静多了。自从第一次戴上多伦多蓝鸟的球帽以来，Barriera遭遇了一连串的伤病：
2023年：手肘、肩膀和二头肌问题；2024年：接受了汤米·约翰手术（Tommy John）与内部支架植入；2025年：前臂骨折。
但现在他回到了亚利桑那秋季联赛，重新穿上了俱乐部的装备，作为梅萨日落索斯队的一员代表球队出战。这段场边养伤的时光剥夺了他从小就热爱的做的事情：竞争。
“这绝对是一段很好的反思期，让我真正去琢磨作为一名球员和一个人，我究竟是谁，”Barriera说道。“最重要的是，我明白了棒球只是生活的一部分，我的身份不能完全寄托在这项运动上，因为这是一项充满失败的游戏，我们所有人都知道这一点。”
“但说实话，重新爱上这项运动的感觉真是太棒了。”
Barriera毫不吝啬地赞扬了他强大的后盾支持系统，认为这是帮助他不断重返投手丘的关键。在经历四个职业赛季后，他总共只投了66局，但当他迈着6尺2寸的身躯冲向打击区时，心中曾有过的迟疑和自我怀疑终于消散了。他依然全神贯注地想要成为一名大联盟球员。
但在他能够前往罗杰斯中心之前，他首先得离开位于佛罗里达州达尼丁的训练基地。这比2022年7月时的任何预期都要漫长得多，但在8月23日，Barriera迎来了他职业生涯的首次升级，晋升至高阶1A温哥华，并在那里结束了2026年的常规赛。
这位左投手在三个级别中总共投了38.2局，期间又因一次与手臂无关的问题短暂进入伤病名单。他的保送率偏高（每9局6.7次四坏球），但三振率超过了每局1次，地滚球率达到了66.7%，在所有多伦多蓝鸟小联盟球员中排名第二（投球局数不少于30局）。
“他拥有一些独特的球路，”梅萨投手教练Bo Martino（同时也是洛杉矶天使组织中的投手表现协调员）在谈到Barriera时说道。“我认为对于这些球员来说，关键往往在于不要抛弃这种独特性，而是要将之发扬光大。了解你是谁，建立对自己的信心，并具备勇于对决打者的心态。我认为（在秋季联赛中）好的一点是，我们虽然想要赢得比赛，但我们更能够去培养这些球员，为他们未来的成功打好基础。”

在亚利桑那秋季联赛期间，Barriera已经出场5次，全部是以中继身份登场。（他在周一晚上的最近一次出场中提前退场。）他已经完全放弃了变速球，而他的两款直球——一种类似卡特球的四缝线直球和带有二缝线轨迹的沉球——球速维持在时速91到93英里左右，最快达到94.6英里。但全场的明星依然是他的滑球，球速在80英里中段，具有极大的横向位移且能制造挥空；在为日落索斯队送出的6次三振中，有4次都是用这记变化球解决的。
“说实话，它演变了很多。这绝对是一颗能带来信心的球，同时也能找回投直球的感觉，”Barriera说道。“我试图像投直球一样猛烈挥臂，像直球一样走同一条进垒轨迹，然后信任它的位移。”
归根结底，Barriera在整个2027赛季时也只有23岁，这为他未来某天冲击大联盟球队留出了充足的发展空间。多伦多蓝鸟曾将Ricky Tiedemann（他们的第10号潜力新秀）在经历多年类似的挫折后转型为牛棚投手，这最终帮助他开辟了一条通往大联盟的捷径。
“当我处于最佳状态时，我就是火力全开、全力竞争，为我的球队争取最好的获胜机会，”他说。“我认为这就是我作为一名投手的本色，无论是作为先发投手还是后援投手——无论他们想让我怎么做，我都能完成任务。”
